recipes.name: AnimateDiff
recipes.providerZh: 上海人工智能实验室 / 香港中文大学 MMLab
recipes.summary: AnimateDiff is the classic motion-module approach to text-to-video: it animates existing Stable Diffusion image models by inserting a trained temporal module, rather than training a video model from scratch.
recipes.summaryZh: AnimateDiff 是经典的「运动模块」式文生视频方法：通过在现成的 Stable Diffusion 图像模型中插入训练好的时序模块来让静态模型动起来，而不是从头训练视频模型。已用发布的 checkpoint 验证：WorldFoundry 的输出与官方 RealisticVision `scripts.animate` demo 完全一致。别名：animate-diff、animate_diff。

recipes.name: Astra
recipes.summary: Astra is an interactive world model with camera control built over a Wan2.1 backbone: from a single image it rolls out navigable world video following camera actions.
recipes.summaryZh: Astra 是基于 Wan2.1 基座、带相机控制的交互式世界模型：从单张图出发，跟随相机动作滚动生成可导航的世界视频。已用发布的 checkpoint 验证：官方 garden_1 Sekai demo 使用 forward_left 相机控制，输出 832x480、20 fps 的 97 帧。

recipes.name: Being-H0.5
recipes.summary: Being-H0.5 is BeingBeyond's 2B-parameter cross-embodiment VLA policy. Four checkpoint lines are available: base, LIBERO, RoboCasa, and a combined LIBERO+RoboCasa variant.
recipes.summaryZh: Being-H0.5 是 BeingBeyond 的 2B 参数跨本体 VLA 策略。提供四条 checkpoint 线：base、LIBERO、RoboCasa，以及 LIBERO+RoboCasa 合并变体。已用 LIBERO checkpoint 验证：通过公开 pipeline 在 GPU 上运行 get_action，并输出 action_trace 产物。

recipes.name: CameraCtrl
recipes.provider: The Chinese University of Hong Kong / Shanghai AI Laboratory
recipes.providerZh: 香港中文大学 / 上海人工智能实验室
recipes.summary: CameraCtrl pioneered plug-and-play camera control for text-to-video diffusion: it trains a camera encoder over Plücker embeddings so trajectories can steer generation without retraining the base model.
recipes.summaryZh: CameraCtrl 开创了文生视频扩散的即插即用相机控制：基于 Plücker 嵌入训练相机编码器，让轨迹无需重训基座即可操控生成。WorldFoundry 按官方轨迹文生视频 demo 在树内运行：输入文本提示词与相机轨迹文件，输出视频。

recipes.name: CogVideoX
recipes.summary: CogVideoX is Zhipu AI's open video generation family, one of the most widely used open T2V/I2V baselines. It ships three runnable variants — 2B text-to-video, 5B text-to-video, and 5B image-to-video.
recipes.summaryZh: CogVideoX 是智谱 AI 的开源视频生成系列，也是使用最广的开源文生/图生视频基线之一。它提供三个可运行 variant——2B 文生视频、5B 文生视频、5B 图生视频。权重可从 Hugging Face 原生加载（THUDM/CogVideoX-5b），也可用 model_path 指向本地镜像。

recipes.name: Cosmos Transfer 2.5
recipes.summary: Cosmos Transfer 2.5 does controlled world-to-world translation: it takes structured control inputs (e.g. edge maps or simulation renders) and generates photoreal world video that follows them — the sim-to-real arm of the Cosmos family.
recipes.summaryZh: Cosmos Transfer 2.5 做受控的世界到世界转换：接受结构化控制输入（如边缘图或仿真渲染），生成遵循这些控制的写实世界视频——是 Cosmos 家族的 sim-to-real 分支。它复用与 Predict 2.5 相同的原生 runner、Reason1 条件器、flow-UniPC 调度器与 Wan VAE，仅新增 VACE 控制分支。

recipes.name: Depth Any Panoramas
recipes.summary: Depth Any Panoramas (DAP) is Insta360's metric depth estimator for panoramic images — full 360° depth from a single equirectangular input. WorldFoundry runs it as a geometry prior with the Insta360-Research/DAP-weights checkpoint.
recipes.summaryZh: Depth Any Panoramas（DAP）是影石 Insta360 面向全景图像的米制深度估计器，从单张等距柱状投影图得到完整 360° 深度。

recipes.name: Depth Anything 3 Metric Prior
recipes.summary: Depth Anything 3 Metric Prior is the metric-depth head of ByteDance Seed's Depth Anything 3, packaged as a standalone geometry prior.
recipes.summaryZh: Depth Anything 3 Metric Prior 是字节 Seed 团队 Depth Anything 3 的米制深度头，以独立几何先验的形式提供。它使用 depth-anything/DA3METRIC-LARGE checkpoint，Prior-Depth-Anything 细化器即以它的输出为条件完成验证。

recipes.name: Depth Anything V1
recipes.provider: TikTok / The University of Hong Kong
recipes.summary: Depth Anything V1 is the foundation model for relative monocular depth that popularized large-scale unlabeled-data depth training.
recipes.summaryZh: Depth Anything V1 是让「大规模无标注数据训练深度」流行起来的相对单目深度基础模型。树内 pipeline 导出相对深度与几何产物；Studio 路径已验证可产出非空深度图。

recipes.name: Depth Anything V2
recipes.provider: TikTok / The University of Hong Kong
recipes.summary: Depth Anything V2 is the sharper, synthetic-data-trained successor to V1, used in WorldFoundry as a monocular and metric depth prior. It loads the depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Large checkpoint.
recipes.summaryZh: Depth Anything V2 是 V1 的后继者，用合成数据训练、细节更锐利，

recipes.name: DIAMOND
recipes.provider: University of Geneva / University of Edinburgh / Microsoft Research
recipes.providerZh: 日内瓦大学 / 爱丁堡大学 / 微软研究院
recipes.summary: DIAMOND (DIffusion As a Model Of eNvironment Dreams) trains reinforcement-learning agents entirely inside a diffusion world model, with released Atari agents and a playable CS:GO world model (NeurIPS 2024).
recipes.summaryZh: DIAMOND（DIffusion As a Model Of eNvironment Dreams）让强化学习智能体完全在扩散世界模型内训练，官方发布了 Atari 智能体与可游玩的 CS:GO 世界模型（NeurIPS 2024）。

recipes.name: DualCamCtrl
recipes.provider: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) (EnVision Lab)
recipes.providerZh: 香港科技大学（广州）EnVision 实验室
recipes.summary: DualCamCtrl controls video generation with a camera trajectory plus a depth image: the RGB and depth conditions together pin down scene geometry so the generated camera move stays physically grounded.
recipes.summaryZh: DualCamCtrl 用「相机轨迹 + 深度图」控制视频生成：RGB 与深度条件共同确定场景几何，使生成的相机运动保持物理可信。WorldFoundry 沿用官方 RGB/深度/相机 demo 的输入。

recipes.name: DUSt3R
recipes.providerZh: NAVER 欧洲实验室（NAVER Labs Europe）
recipes.summary: DUSt3R made unconstrained two-view 3D reconstruction easy: feed it two images — no calibration, no poses — and it directly regresses aligned pointmaps.
recipes.summaryZh: DUSt3R 让无约束双视图 3D 重建变得简单：给它两张图——无需标定、无需位姿——直接回归对齐的点图。已用发布的 checkpoint 验证：Studio 推理从内置多视图测试用例产出有限点云。
tasks: feed-forward multi-view 3D reconstruction and geometry estimation
tasksZh: feed-forward multi-view 3D reconstruction and geometry estimation

recipes.name: FantasyWorld
recipes.providerZh: 阿里巴巴（高德 Fantasy-AMAP 团队）
recipes.summary: FantasyWorld does geometry-consistent world modeling by unifying video and 3D prediction: from an image it produces camera-controllable world video that stays geometrically coherent.
recipes.summaryZh: FantasyWorld 通过统一视频与 3D 预测实现几何一致的世界建模：从一张图生成相机可控、几何连贯的世界视频。提供两个 variant：默认的 Wan2.1 pipeline 与 Wan2.2 pipeline。
aliases: Geometry-Consistent World Modeling via Unified Video and 3D Prediction

recipes.name: FlashWorld
recipes.summary: FlashWorld generates 3D scenes in seconds: from one image (plus optional prompt) it produces a camera-navigable 3D scene rather than a flat clip.
recipes.summaryZh: FlashWorld 数秒内生成 3D 场景：从一张图（可附提示词）产出可相机游走的 3D 场景，而非平面视频。图像条件的相机场景 demo 已用发布的 FlashWorld 与 Wan2.2 资产验证。
tasks: fast 3D scene generation from image or text
tasksZh: 图像或文本快速 3D 场景生成

recipes.name: GeoCalib
recipes.providerZh: 苏黎世联邦理工学院（CVG 组）
recipes.summary: GeoCalib estimates camera calibration and the gravity direction from a single image by combining geometric optimization with deep learning.
recipes.summaryZh: GeoCalib 通过几何优化与深度学习结合，从单张图像估计相机标定与重力方向。

recipes.name: GigaBrain-0
recipes.summary: GigaBrain-0 is GigaAI's 3.5B VLA foundation policy with subtask prediction, released as GigaBrain-0-3.5B-Base and the 0.1 refresh under Apache-2.0.
recipes.summaryZh: GigaBrain-0 是极佳科技（GigaAI）的 3.5B VLA 基础策略，支持子任务预测，发布 GigaBrain-0-3.5B-Base 与 0.1 更新版，Apache-2.0 许可。已使用 GigaBrain-0.1 权重验证：树内运行时使用转换的 LeRobot RoboTwin 统计输出 CUDA action_trace。

recipes.name: HunyuanWorld-Mirror
recipes.summary: HunyuanWorld-Mirror is Tencent's universal 3D reconstruction model: feed it images and it returns point clouds, Gaussian splats, depth, normals, and camera parameters in one pass.
recipes.summaryZh: HunyuanWorld-Mirror 是腾讯的通用 3D 重建模型：输入图像，一次前向返回点云、高斯泼溅、深度、法线与相机参数。已用 tencent/HunyuanWorld-Mirror checkpoint 验证：GPU 推理产出点云 PLY、高斯泼溅 PLY、深度图、法线图与 scene.rrd。

recipes.name: HY-WorldPlay
recipes.summary: HY-WorldPlay is Tencent's real-time interactive world video model: starting from an image, it follows pose/action input to roll the world forward — the interactive arm of the Hunyuan world stack.
recipes.summaryZh: HY-WorldPlay 是腾讯的实时交互世界视频模型：从一张图出发，跟随位姿/动作输入向前滚动世界——混元世界栈的交互分支。已按官方 image-pose-video 路径与官方 8 卡执行档案验证。

recipes.name: Infinite-World
recipes.summary: Infinite-World is MeiGen-AI's long-horizon world video model: from one image it navigates and extends a world over long durations.
recipes.summaryZh: Infinite-World 是美团 MeiGen-AI 的长时程世界视频模型：从一张图出发，长时间地在世界中导航与扩展。已在 GPU 上按官方图像条件导航 demo 设置验证：pipeline 生成长时程世界视频及预览元数据。

recipes.name: InSpatio World 1.5
recipes.summary: Native inference reuses the existing causal Wan graph, UMT5 encoder, Wan VAE, causal sampler and in-tree DA3.
recipes.summaryZh: InSpatio World 1.5 是来自 inspatio 的世界模型，支持图生视频、视频到视频、轨迹条件视频、新视角合成。

recipes.name: InSpatio-World
recipes.summary: InSpatio-World is a 1.3B video-conditioned world generator: given a video and a target trajectory it synthesizes trajectory-conditioned novel views of the same world.
recipes.summaryZh: InSpatio-World 是 1.3B 的视频条件世界生成器：给定一段视频与目标轨迹，合成同一世界的轨迹条件新视角。已用发布的 checkpoint 验证：pipeline 生成的 297 帧视频通过了视觉检查。

recipes.name: InSpatio-WorldFM
recipes.summary: InSpatio-WorldFM is a 3D world foundation model for spatial intelligence and frame generation, released with code and weights (inspatio/WorldFM on Hugging Face, Apache-2.0).
recipes.summaryZh: InSpatio-WorldFM 是面向空间智能与帧生成的 3D 世界基础模型，代码与权重均已发布（Hugging Face 上的 inspatio/WorldFM，Apache-2.0）。WorldFoundry runner 在统一环境中以本地 WorldFM 资产运行官方 meta.json demo，输出官方的视频与全景图产物。

recipes.name: Kairos Sensenova
recipes.summary: Kairos Sensenova is SenseTime's embodied world-model video generator: a 4B model covering text-, image-, and text+image-to-video with a robot-oriented distilled recipe.
recipes.summaryZh: Kairos Sensenova 是商汤的具身世界模型视频生成器：4B 模型覆盖文生、图生与文+图生视频，并有面向机器人的蒸馏配方。已验证：默认的 robot 4B 480P DMD 文生视频配方以 8 个 torchrun rank 运行。

recipes.name: LingBot-World
recipes.providerZh: 蚂蚁灵波科技（Robbyant，蚂蚁集团）
recipes.summary: LingBot-World is Robbyant's camera-controlled world video model. Validated with the base-cam checkpoint on the official camera-control demo: the pipeline generates all 161 frames at 832x464 and 16 fps with 70 denoising steps, and a…
recipes.summaryZh: LingBot-World 是蚂蚁灵波的相机可控世界视频模型。已用 base-cam checkpoint 按官方相机控制 demo 验证：pipeline 以 70 步去噪生成全部 161 帧（832x464，16 fps），四张 A100 的紧凑拓扑也能完成同样的完整设置。

recipes.name: LoGeR
recipes.summary: LoGeR reconstructs 3D scenes, camera trajectories, and point clouds from input views. Validated with the Junyi42/LoGeR checkpoint: inference produces finite camera poses, depth, and a 601,570-vertex point cloud.
recipes.summaryZh: LoGeR 从输入视图重建 3D 场景、相机轨迹与点云。已用 Junyi42/LoGeR checkpoint 验证：推理产出有限的相机位姿、深度与 601,570 顶点的点云。

recipes.name: LongVie 2
recipes.providerZh: 上海人工智能实验室（Vchitect 团队）
recipes.summary: LongVie 2 is the second-generation controllable long-video framework from the Vchitect team.
recipes.summaryZh: LongVie 2 是 Vchitect 团队第二代可控长视频框架。它以排队的 81 帧控制视频分段生成，每次续写复用上一段末帧、八帧历史与噪声状态。已使用发布权重验证：Studio 默认的四卡路径可生成并解码全部 81 帧（640x352）。

recipes.name: Lyra
recipes.summary: Lyra is NVIDIA's generative world model family for exploration: from an image or video (Lyra-1) or from actions (Lyra-2) it produces an explorable world video.
recipes.summaryZh: Lyra 是英伟达面向探索的生成式世界模型家族：Lyra-1 从图像或视频、Lyra-2 从动作输入生成可探索的世界视频。已用本地资产验证：Lyra-1 跑通官方静态单图 SDG demo，Lyra-2 跑通官方 ZoomGS 单图前向导航 demo。默认 runner 使用 Lyra-2。
tasksZh: 开放生成式 3D 与 4D 世界模型

recipes.name: Matrix-Game 2.0
recipes.summary: Matrix-Game 2.0 is Skywork's real-time-oriented interactive world model generation: an auto-regressive diffusion design that follows keyboard/mouse actions across game scenes.
recipes.summaryZh: Matrix-Game 2.0 是昆仑万维面向实时的交互式世界模型：自回归扩散设计，在游戏场景中跟随键鼠动作。已使用官方 bench 动作，在 12 fps、352x640 下以 15 个 latent 帧的短流程对照官方 universal 模式验证。

recipes.name: Matrix-Game 3.0
recipes.summary: Matrix-Game 3.0 is the third Skywork generation, pushing interactive world video to higher resolution with few-step inference.
recipes.summaryZh: Matrix-Game 3.0 是昆仑万维的第三代，以少步推理把交互式世界视频推到更高分辨率。已在官方 cityscape 图像条件 demo 上验证：「forward + camera_r」动作、12 次迭代、3 步推理、704x1280，使用 int8 量化、编译 VAE 与 mg_lightvae 解码器。

recipes.name: Metric3D
recipes.providerZh: 大疆创新 / 浙江大学
recipes.summary: Metric3D recovers metric-scale depth from a single image by normalizing images into a canonical camera space, which lets one model generalize across cameras.
recipes.summaryZh: Metric3D 通过把图像归一化到规范相机空间，从单张图像恢复米制尺度深度，使单一模型能够跨相机泛化。WorldFoundry 将其用作米制深度先验，它也是 ViPE SLAM 配置中的默认米制深度模型。

recipes.name: MolmoAct2
recipes.summary: MolmoAct2 is AI2's second-generation action reasoning model with a broad Apache-2.0 checkpoint zoo: base, Think (depth-reasoning), DROID (Franka), Bimanual YAM, SO100/101, and LIBERO checkpoints.
recipes.summaryZh: MolmoAct2 是 AI2 的第二代动作推理模型，Apache-2.0 checkpoint 阵容齐全：base、Think（深度推理）、DROID（Franka）、双臂 YAM、SO100/101 与 LIBERO。WorldFoundry 将官方 DROID/YAM predict_action 契约作为 action_trace pipeline 运行，无需外部源码检出。

recipes.name: MonST3R
recipes.providerZh: Google DeepMind / 加州大学伯克利分校
recipes.summary: MonST3R extends the DUSt3R pointmap approach to dynamic scenes: it estimates per-timestep geometry directly from video, recovering shape and motion without a static-scene assumption.
recipes.summaryZh: MonST3R 把 DUSt3R 的点图方法扩展到动态场景：直接从视频逐时刻估计几何，在不假设静态场景的前提下同时恢复形状与运动。已通过 Studio 在 CUDA 上验证：pipeline 产出含 51 个几何体、点数据有限的合法 GLB 场景。
tasks: geometry estimation in the presence of motion

recipes.name: MotionCtrl
recipes.summary: MotionCtrl is a unified, flexible motion controller for video generation: it controls camera motion and object motion independently in one model (SIGGRAPH 2024).
recipes.summaryZh: MotionCtrl 是统一、灵活的视频生成运动控制器：在单一模型中独立控制相机运动与物体运动（SIGGRAPH 2024）。已使用发布的 MotionCtrl 权重验证：相机运动 demo 可使用内置相机位姿示例完整运行。

recipes.name: NeoVerse
recipes.summary: NeoVerse is a 4D world model that adds 4D-aware control and reconstruction to a Wan video backbone to enhance world generation. Validated on the README-style tilt_up video demo with local NeoVerse assets.
recipes.summaryZh: NeoVerse 是一个 4D 世界模型，在 Wan 视频基座上加入 4D 感知的控制与重建，用于增强世界生成。已用本地 NeoVerse 资产在 README 风格的 tilt_up 视频 demo 上验证。
tasks: 4D world modeling from in-the-wild monocular videos
tasksZh: 野外单目视频 4D 世界建模

recipes.name: OpenVLA
recipes.summary: OpenVLA is the widely used open 7B vision-language-action model (MIT license): a Prismatic-based VLM fine-tuned on Open X-Embodiment robot demonstrations to predict discretized actions.
recipes.summaryZh: OpenVLA 是广泛使用的开放 7B 视觉-语言-动作模型（MIT 许可）：基于 Prismatic 的 VLM 在 Open X-Embodiment 机器人示范上微调，预测离散化动作。提供 openvla-7b 与 LIBERO-10 微调版两个 checkpoint；base 路由已以 unnorm_key=bridge_orig 验证。

recipes.name: Prior Depth Anything
recipes.summary: Prior Depth Anything is a depth-completion prior: it takes any coarse or sparse metric-depth prior plus an image and refines them into a dense, sharper metric depth map.
recipes.summaryZh: Prior Depth Anything 是深度补全先验：接受任意粗糙或稀疏的米制深度先验加一张图像，将其细化为致密且更锐利的米制深度图。已用官方 checkpoint 验证：可对真实的 Depth Anything 3 米制深度条件完成细化。

recipes.name: ReCamMaster
recipes.summary: ReCamMaster re-renders an existing video along a new camera trajectory — camera-controlled generative rendering from a single video.
recipes.summaryZh: ReCamMaster 让已有视频沿新的相机轨迹重新渲染，即从单个视频出发的相机可控生成式渲染。已使用本地 ReCamMaster 与 Wan2.1 资产验证：runner 复现官方相机轨迹 video-to-video demo。
aliases: Camera-Controlled Generative Rendering from A Single Video

recipes.name: RoboFlamingo
recipes.summary: RoboFlamingo adapts the OpenFlamingo vision-language model into a robot imitation policy: a lightweight policy head turns the VLM's visual-language features into actions.
recipes.summaryZh: RoboFlamingo 将 OpenFlamingo 视觉-语言模型改造为机器人模仿策略：轻量策略头把 VLM 的视觉-语言特征转为动作。已在 GPU 上验证：就位 RoboFlamingo、OpenFlamingo 与 MPT checkpoint 后，公开 pipeline 可产出 CUDA 动作轨迹。

recipes.name: SCOPE
recipes.summary: SCOPE is an interactive game world model over a Wan backbone: image plus per-step actions in, game-world video out (paper arXiv 2605.23345).
recipes.summaryZh: SCOPE 是基于 Wan 基座的交互式游戏世界模型：输入图像与逐步动作，输出游戏世界视频（论文 arXiv 2605.23345）。已用 zizhaotong/SCOPE 权重验证：图像+动作到视频的 demo 可基于示例图与动作 parquet 端到端运行。

notes: Unified HuggingFace repo contains SCOPE DiT shards, UMT5-XXL text encoder, Wan2.2 VAE, and tokenizer files.

recipes.name: Show-o
recipes.summary: Show-o (Xie et al., Show Lab at NUS with ByteDance, arXiv 2408.12528) is a single 1.3B transformer that unifies multimodal understanding and generation.
recipes.summaryZh: Show-o（Xie 等，新加坡国立大学 Show Lab 与 ByteDance，arXiv 2408.12528）是一个 1.3B 的单一 Transformer，把多模态理解与生成放在同一套权重里。它从 Phi-1.5 初始化，而不是把独立扩散专家接到 MLLM 上。

recipes.name: Solaris
recipes.summary: Solaris is a multi-agent interactive video world model from NYU's VisionX group (paper arXiv 2602.22208): multiple agents act inside one generated world.
recipes.summaryZh: Solaris 是纽约大学 VisionX 组的多智能体交互视频世界模型（论文 arXiv 2602.22208）：多个智能体在同一个生成世界中行动。WorldFoundry 使用官方 Orbax checkpoint（nyu-visionx/solaris）与官方评估数据集运行推理，二者从 Hugging Face 或本地镜像加载。

notes: Official Solaris Orbax checkpoint bundle containing solaris.pt, clip.pt, and vae.pt.

recipes.name: Splatt3R
recipes.summary: Splatt3R predicts a 3D Gaussian splat scene directly from an uncalibrated image pair — zero shot, no camera parameters, no per-scene optimization.
recipes.summaryZh: Splatt3R 直接从未标定的图像对预测 3D 高斯泼溅场景——零样本、无需相机参数、无需逐场景优化。已用发布权重验证：在内置示例视图上的 GPU 推理生成含 344,064 个高斯的 PLY。

recipes.name: StarVLA
recipes.summary: StarVLA is a Lego-like modular VLA framework. Validated with the Qwen3-VL-OFT-LIBERO-4in1 checkpoint and the Qwen3-VL-4B base VLM: the official QwenOFT predict_action runs on an 80GB GPU.
recipes.summaryZh: StarVLA 是乐高式模块化 VLA 框架。已用 Qwen3-VL-OFT-LIBERO-4in1 checkpoint 与 Qwen3-VL-4B 基座 VLM 验证：官方 QwenOFT predict_action 可在 80GB GPU 上运行。另提供基于 Wan2.2 的 WM4A 世界-动作 checkpoint。

recipes.name: Step-Video-T2V
recipes.summary: Step-Video-T2V is StepFun's large open text-to-video model (30B parameters upstream, MIT weights at stepfun-ai/stepvideo-t2v).
recipes.summaryZh: Step-Video-T2V 是阶跃星辰的大规模开源文生视频模型（上游 300 亿参数，MIT 权重位于 stepfun-ai/stepvideo-t2v）。

recipes.name: VGGT-Omega
recipes.summary: VGGT-Omega is the extended VGGT release published under facebook/VGGT-Omega, covering 3D reconstruction, Gaussian splatting, and novel view synthesis.
recipes.summaryZh: VGGT-Omega 是以 facebook/VGGT-Omega 发布的 VGGT 扩展版本，覆盖 3D 重建、高斯泼溅与新视角合成。已在 GPU 上验证：单图输出与固定的上游 commit 完全一致，官方场景导出路径可端到端运行。

recipes.name: VMem
recipes.summary: VMem is an interactive video scene generation model with a surfel-indexed view memory: as you navigate a scene, it remembers which surfaces were seen from where, keeping new views consistent with the past.
recipes.summaryZh: VMem 是带「面元索引视图记忆」的交互式视频场景生成模型：当你在场景中游走时，它记住哪些表面曾从哪些视角被看到，使新视角与历史保持一致。已用发布的 VMem 与 CUT3R checkpoint 验证：pipeline 复现了官方导航 demo。

recipes.name: Wan2.1
recipes.summary: Wan2.1 is Alibaba Tongyi Lab's open video generation family and the backbone of many world-model and control models in WorldFoundry.
recipes.summaryZh: Wan2.1 是阿里通义实验室的开源视频生成系列，也是 WorldFoundry 中许多世界模型与控制类模型的基座。提供四个 variant：T2V 1.3B、T2V 14B，以及 480p 与 720p 的 I2V 14B，均来自官方 Wan-Video GitHub 与 Wan-AI Hugging Face 仓库。

recipes.name: Wan2.2
recipes.summary: Wan2.2 is the next Wan generation after Wan2.1, with its own code and checkpoints. It has three variants: T2V A14B and I2V A14B (MoE) and TI2V 5B, a compact text+image-to-video model.
recipes.summaryZh: Wan2.2 是 Wan2.1 之后的下一代 Wan，代码与 checkpoint 独立发布。它有三个 variant：T2V A14B 与 I2V A14B（MoE），以及紧凑的图文生视频模型 TI2V 5B。已用发布的 checkpoint 验证：TI2V 5B 以 50 步生成 1280x704、24 FPS 的 121 帧视频。

recipes.name: Warp-as-History
recipes.summary: Warp-as-History (WAH) is a camera-controlled image-to-video method: it warps the input image along the requested camera path and treats those warps as the generation history that a video model then refines.
recipes.summaryZh: Warp-as-History（WAH）是相机可控的图生视频方法：沿请求的相机轨迹对输入图像做 warp，并把这些 warp 当作「历史帧」交给视频模型细化。已用 Helios-Distilled 与 LoRA checkpoint 在 GPU 上验证：复现了官方 BMX/涂鸦 warp 视频 demo。

recipes.name: WorldCam
recipes.providerZh: KAIST（韩国科学技术院）/ Adobe Research / MAUM AI
recipes.summary: WorldCam, from KAIST's CV Lab with Adobe Research and MAUM AI, is an interactive world model with camera-pose control for long-horizon game video.
recipes.summaryZh: WorldCam 由 KAIST CV Lab 联合 Adobe Research 与 MAUM AI 发布，是支持相机位姿控制的交互式世界模型，面向长时程游戏视频。

recipes.name: WorldCrafter
recipes.summary: Reuses shared Helios transformer, scheduler, latent preparation and VGGT layers.
recipes.summaryZh: WorldCrafter 是来自 TencentARC 的世界模型，支持文生视频、图生视频、相机可控视频、世界模型。

recipes.name: WorldCrafter Base
recipes.summary: WorldCrafter Base is a world model from TencentARC for text-to-video, image-to-video, camera-controlled video, and world model.
recipes.summaryZh: WorldCrafter Base 是来自 TencentARC 的世界模型，支持文生视频、图生视频、相机可控视频、世界模型。

recipes.name: WorldCrafter Fast
recipes.summary: WorldCrafter Fast is a world model from TencentARC for text-to-video, image-to-video, camera-controlled video, and world model.
recipes.summaryZh: WorldCrafter Fast 是来自 TencentARC 的世界模型，支持文生视频、图生视频、相机可控视频、世界模型。

recipes.name: YUME
recipes.summary: YUME is an interactive world-video generator: from an image (and for YUME-1.5, text) it produces explorable first-person world videos that respond to keyboard-style motion input.
recipes.summaryZh: YUME 是交互式世界视频生成器：从一张图（YUME-1.5 还支持文本）生成可探索的第一人称世界视频，响应键盘式运动输入。提供两个 Apache-2.0 许可的变体：YUME I2V 使用官方 Yume-I2V-540P checkpoint，YUME-1.5 使用 Yume-5B-720P。
tasks: image/video conditioned interactive world video generation
tasksZh: image/video conditioned interactive world video generation

recipes.name: ZeroScope
recipes.summary: ZeroScope is a community fine-tune of ModelScopeT2V optimized for watermark-free 16:9 video, released in 576w and XL upscale checkpoints by the creator cerspense.
recipes.summaryZh: ZeroScope 是社区作者 cerspense 对 ModelScopeT2V 的微调版，面向无水印 16:9 视频优化，发布了 576w 与 XL 放大两个 checkpoint。已验证：在所选配置下，WorldFoundry 输出与官方 Diffusers 路径一致。

recipes.name: AC3D
recipes.summary: AC3D analyzes and improves camera control in video diffusion: it is a ControlNet-style plugin for CogVideoX.
recipes.summaryZh: AC3D 分析并改进视频扩散中的相机控制，是 CogVideoX 的 ControlNet 风格插件。WorldFoundry 已集成官方推理适配器；实际推理仍需本地 AC3D ControlNet 和对应 CogVideoX 底座权重。

recipes.name: Action Chunking Transformer
recipes.summary: ACT (Action Chunking Transformer) is the classic imitation-learning policy behind the ALOHA line of work: instead of predicting one action at a time it predicts chunks of future actions, smoothing control and reducing compounding error.
recipes.summaryZh: ACT（Action Chunking Transformer）是 ALOHA 系列工作背后的经典模仿学习策略：不逐步预测单个动作，而是预测未来动作块，使控制更平滑并降低误差累积。WorldFoundry 完整执行该策略，包括 DETR-VAE、transformer、ResNet 骨干、预处理与动作块聚合。

recipes.name: AHA-WAM
recipes.summary: AHA-WAM is a world-action model for manipulation: paired video and action experts share a mixture cache so the policy benefits from predictive world modeling.
recipes.summaryZh: AHA-WAM 是面向操作的世界-动作模型：视频与动作专家成对并共享 mixture cache，使策略受益于预测式世界建模。它使用 MIT 许可的 SereneC/AHA-WAM-RoboTwin2.0 checkpoint（robotwin_ahawam.pt），Wan 系列 VAE 与 UMT5 文本编码器权重来自 DiffSynth-Studio 转换版本，全部在进程内运行。

recipes.name: AlayaWorld
recipes.summary: AlayaWorld is a camera-controlled interactive world model for long video: from an image it rolls out world video autoregressively with action control and DA3-backed spatial memory.
recipes.summaryZh: AlayaWorld 是面向长视频的相机可控交互式世界模型：从一张图出发，带动作控制与 DA3 空间记忆自回归滚动生成世界视频。已用发布的 33.6 GB 合并 checkpoint 验证：pipeline 在 A100 上开启空间记忆，生成官方 case1 的首个 chunk（32 帧 H.264，544×960，24 fps）。

recipes.name: AlayaWorld v1.1
recipes.summary: AlayaWorld v1.1 is a camera-controlled image-to-video world model with ViGeo spatial memory. It offers autoregressive (AR) inference and four-step DMD inference.
recipes.summaryZh: AlayaWorld v1.1 是带 ViGeo 空间记忆的相机控制图生视频世界模型，提供自回归（AR）推理和四步 DMD 推理。

recipes.name: Allegro
recipes.summary: Allegro is an open text-to-video and image-to-video generation model. WorldFoundry runs it through the TI2V (text+image to video) route: a prompt, optionally anchored by a start image, produces a video.
recipes.summaryZh: Allegro 是开源的文生视频/图生视频模型。

recipes.name: Astronex-World
recipes.summary: Astronex-World exposes causal and bidirectional camera/action-conditioned video inference.
recipes.summaryZh: Astronex-World 支持相机和动作条件下的因果及双向视频推理。

recipes.name: ATI-Wan2.1-14B
recipes.summary: ATI (Any Trajectory Instruction) turns trajectory drawing into video control: draw point trajectories over an input image and the Wan2.1-14B-based model animates objects, camera, or both along them.
recipes.summaryZh: ATI（Any Trajectory Instruction）把「画轨迹」变成视频控制：在输入图上画出点轨迹，基于 Wan2.1-14B 的模型就让物体、相机或两者沿轨迹运动。

recipes.name: Bernini
recipes.summary: Bernini is ByteDance's unified any-to-any visual generation model: one checkpoint covers text-to-image, image editing, text-to-video, video-to-video, and reference-guided video.
recipes.summaryZh: Bernini 是字节跳动的统一「任意到任意」视觉生成模型：一个 checkpoint 同时覆盖文生图、图像编辑、文生视频、视频到视频与参考引导视频。完整的 ByteDance/Bernini-Diffusers checkpoint 内含 7B 语义规划器与 14B 渲染器。WorldFoundry 自带官方推理源码，直接加载自包含的 Diffusers checkpoint，无需外部 Bernini 检出。

recipes.name: Bernini-R 1.3B
recipes.summary: Bernini-R 1.3B is the small renderer-only member of ByteDance's Bernini family — a 1.3B rendering checkpoint fine-tuned from Wan2.1 1.3B, covering the same six task types as its larger siblings.
recipes.summaryZh: Bernini-R 1.3B 是字节 Bernini 系列中的小型「仅渲染器」成员——由 Wan2.1 1.3B 微调而来的 1.3B 渲染 checkpoint，覆盖与大模型相同的六类任务。它是单卡体验 Bernini 任务面的实用选择。WorldFoundry 树内内置渲染器推理代码，加载 ByteDance/Bernini-R-1.3B-Diffusers。

recipes.name: Bernini-R 14B
recipes.summary: Bernini-R 14B is the renderer-only release of ByteDance's Bernini family: the 14B rendering model packaged without the 7B semantic planner.
recipes.summaryZh: Bernini-R 14B 是字节 Bernini 系列的「仅渲染器」发布：14B 渲染模型单独打包，不含 7B 语义规划器。它保留同样的六类任务（文生图、图像编辑、文/视频/参考生视频），但直接使用你的输入，不经过规划阶段。WorldFoundry 加载 ByteDance/Bernini-R-Diffusers checkpoint。

recipes.name: Causal-Forcing
recipes.summary: Causal-Forcing distills bidirectional video diffusion into a causal, autoregressive generator — including Causal-Forcing++ few-step variants — so video can be generated chunk by chunk or frame by frame.
recipes.summaryZh: Causal-Forcing 把双向视频扩散蒸馏为因果自回归生成器——包括 Causal-Forcing++ 少步 variant——使视频可以逐 chunk 或逐帧生成。默认使用 chunk-wise checkpoint；frame-wise 与 ++ variant 通过覆盖配置与 checkpoint 路径选择。

recipes.name: CogACT
recipes.summary: CogACT from Microsoft is a componentized VLA: a Prismatic-style Llama-2 VLM handles cognition while a dedicated DiT action module handles control, released in Small/Base/Large variants under MIT.
recipes.summaryZh: 微软的 CogACT 是组件化 VLA：Prismatic 式 Llama-2 VLM 负责认知，专用 DiT 动作模块负责控制，按 Small/Base/Large 三档发布，MIT 许可。

recipes.name: Cosmos Predict 2
recipes.summary: Cosmos Predict 2 is the previous generation of NVIDIA's world foundation model, covering image-to-video and video-to-world generation with 2B and 14B video2world variants.
recipes.summaryZh: Cosmos Predict 2 是英伟达世界基础模型的上一代，覆盖图生视频与视频到世界生成，含 2B 与 14B 两个 video2world variant。WorldFoundry 用自有的去噪器、T5 条件器、Rectified Flow AB2 调度器、Wan 编解码器与标准 runner 组装它，不调用英伟达运行时包或 Diffusers pipeline。

recipes.name: Cosmos Predict 2.5
recipes.summary: Cosmos Predict 2.5 is NVIDIA's world foundation model for physical AI: text, image, or video in — world video out, with 2B and 14B variants.
recipes.summaryZh: Cosmos Predict 2.5 是英伟达面向物理 AI 的世界基础模型：输入文本、图像或视频，输出世界视频，含 2B 与 14B 两个 variant。WorldFoundry 用共享的去噪器、条件器、调度器、解码器与加载器角色原生组装该模型，不依赖 Diffusers。

recipes.name: Cosmos3
recipes.summary: Cosmos3 is the newest, broadest Cosmos generation: one joint-modality model covering text-to-image/video, image/video-to-video, synchronized sound, and structured action inference (policy, forward and inverse dynamics), in Nano and Super…
recipes.summaryZh: Cosmos3 是最新、覆盖面最广的 Cosmos 世代：单一联合模态模型覆盖文生图/视频、图/视频到视频、同步声音，以及结构化动作推断（策略、正向与逆向动力学），含 Nano 与 Super 两个 variant。它通过联合模态 runner 原生运行，使用 Karras flow-UniPC 调度器、Wan VAE38 与仅推理的 AVAE 声音解码器。

recipes.name: Diffusion Policy
recipes.providerZh: 斯坦福大学（REAL 实验室）
recipes.summary: Diffusion Policy is the landmark visuomotor policy that models action generation as conditional denoising diffusion, substantially improving multimodal action distributions over regression policies.
recipes.summaryZh: Diffusion Policy 是里程碑式的视觉运动策略：将动作生成建模为条件去噪扩散，相比回归策略大幅改进多模态动作分布。WorldFoundry 运行发布的低维 PushT 变体，从离线转换、完全解析的配置与纯张量 state dict 重建。

recipes.name: DINO-WM
recipes.summary: DINO-WM builds world models on pre-trained DINOv2 visual features instead of pixels: it predicts future patch features and plans robot behavior by optimizing action sequences against a goal feature state — zero-shot planning without…
recipes.summaryZh: DINO-WM 在预训练 DINOv2 视觉特征（而非像素）上构建世界模型：预测未来 patch 特征，并通过针对目标特征状态优化动作序列来规划机器人行为——无需重建即可零样本规划。WorldFoundry 内置官方规划/评估路径及所需的 env 仿真器。

recipes.name: DreamDojo
recipes.summary: DreamDojo predicts robot-view video from an initial image and normalized robot actions. WorldFoundry integrates the offline 2B GR-1 post-trained teacher and a separate low-step causal student route through native Cosmos components.
recipes.summaryZh: DreamDojo 从初始图像与归一化机器人动作预测机器人视角视频。

recipes.name: DreamDojo Student
recipes.summary: DreamDojo's self-forcing student predicts robot-view video with causal action conditioning and one to four TrigFlow sampling steps. WorldFoundry supports isolated offline rollouts and resident normalized-action streaming.
recipes.summaryZh: DreamDojo self-forcing 学生通过因果动作条件与一至四步 TrigFlow 采样预测机器人视角视频。WorldFoundry 支持独立离线回放与常驻归一化动作流式推理。

recipes.name: DreamX-World 5B
recipes.providerZh: 阿里巴巴（高德地图 AMAP-ML）
recipes.summary: DreamX-World 5B AR is the causal autoregressive profile of Amap's DreamX-World: a resident runtime with latent, attention, cross-attention, and VAE caches that rolls world video forward block by block under action control.
recipes.summaryZh: DreamX-World 5B AR 是高德 DreamX-World 的因果自回归档案：常驻运行时带潜变量、注意力、交叉注意力与 VAE 缓存，在动作控制下逐块向前滚动世界视频。已在单张 A100 上验证：从官方示例图生成有限、可解码的原生九帧 1280x704 块。

recipes.name: DynamiCrafter
recipes.providerZh: 腾讯 AI Lab / 香港中文大学
recipes.summary: DynamiCrafter animates open-domain still images by leveraging video diffusion priors — you give it a picture (optionally a prompt) and it produces a plausible motion clip.
recipes.summaryZh: DynamiCrafter 借助视频扩散先验为开放域静态图片赋予动态——给它一张图（可附提示词），即可生成合理的运动视频。提供两个不同分辨率的 variant：dynamicrafter-512-i2v 与 dynamicrafter-1024-i2v，均为树内 WorldFoundry 运行时。

recipes.name: Déjà View Looping Transformer
recipes.summary: Déjà View Looping Transformer (DVLT) is an NVIDIA multi-view reconstruction model covering 3D reconstruction, camera pose estimation, and depth from image collections, exporting GLB scenes.
recipes.summaryZh: Déjà View Looping Transformer（DVLT）是英伟达的多视图重建模型，覆盖 3D 重建、相机位姿估计与深度估计，输出 GLB 场景。WorldFoundry 的封装是惰性的：仅当 CUDA、依赖、源码、输入与权重全部本地就位时，才运行外部 DVLT 的 GLB 导出路径。

recipes.name: EasyAnimate
recipes.summary: EasyAnimate is Alibaba PAI's DiT-based video generation project, covering text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video. WorldFoundry runs its V5.1 image-to-video route, and WRBench camera-control evaluation uses the same runtime.
recipes.summaryZh: EasyAnimate 是阿里 PAI 团队基于 DiT 的视频生成项目，覆盖文生视频、图生视频与视频到视频。WorldFoundry 运行其 V5.1 图生视频路径，WRBench 相机控制评测使用同一运行时。别名 easyanimate_i2v、easyanimate-i2v 指向该模型。

recipes.name: Echo-Infinity
recipes.summary: Echo-Infinity is JD's autoregressive long-video generator: text in, arbitrarily long video out, generated block by block.
recipes.summaryZh: Echo-Infinity 是京东的自回归长视频生成器：输入文本，逐块生成任意长度的视频。

recipes.name: Echo-Memory
recipes.summary: Echo-Memory Context K=1 is one model in JD's Echo-Memory family, a controlled study of how memory mechanisms affect interactive, action-conditioned world models.
recipes.summaryZh: Echo-Memory Context K=1（单帧上下文）是京东 Echo-Memory 家族中的一个模型，该家族对「记忆机制如何影响交互式动作条件世界模型」做受控研究。它绑定 context_k1/epoch-0.safetensors checkpoint，是最小上下文基线：每个新 chunk 仅以 K=1 帧上下文为条件。checkpoint 来自官方 Hugging Face 仓库的 main 分支。

notes: This is the only Echo-Memory checkpoint file currently served by the official Hugging Face main branch.

recipes.name: Echo-WM
recipes.summary: Echo-WM is an omnimodal world model that jointly evolves video, environmental sound, music, and speech under continuous navigation.
recipes.summaryZh: Echo-WM 是在连续导航控制下联合演化视频、环境音、音乐与语音的全模态世界模型。Base 生成约十秒内容；Flash Preview 使用四步去噪与有界 sink-plus-FIFO 缓存进行自回归滚动。

recipes.name: Emu3.5
recipes.providerZh: 北京智源人工智能研究院（BAAI）
recipes.summary: Emu3.5 is BAAI's native multimodal model for interleaved text and images. WorldFoundry uses the pinned official implementation and emits its protobuf response.
recipes.summaryZh: Emu3.5 是北京智源（BAAI）面向交错文本与图像的原生多模态模型。WorldFoundry 调用固定版本的官方实现并输出其 protobuf 响应。已用发布权重验证：GPU 推理生成文本与可解码图像。它不生成视频。

recipes.name: Evoke
recipes.summary: Official source is bundled at revision 74d268516d95c8fceadd2378f91a73f9f187042b.
recipes.summaryZh: Evoke 是来自 AlayaLab 的世界模型，支持文生视频、图生视频、视频到视频、相机可控视频。

recipes.name: FastVideo CausalWan2.2
recipes.summary: FastVideo CausalWan2.2 is an eight-step causal Wan2.2 rollout that emits video in three-latent-frame blocks while routing between high- and low-noise experts.
recipes.summaryZh: FastVideo CausalWan2.2 是八步因果 Wan2.2 生成模型，以每块三个潜帧推进，并在高、低噪声专家之间切换。

recipes.name: FramePack
recipes.summary: FramePack is a low-memory approach to long image-to-video generation: it packs input frame context into fixed-length representations so generation cost stays roughly constant as the video grows.
recipes.summaryZh: FramePack 是面向长视频图生视频的低显存方案：它把输入帧上下文压缩进定长表示，使生成成本不随视频变长而显著增长。

recipes.name: Gamma-World
recipes.summary: Gamma-World is NVIDIA's multi-agent world model: given per-player start images and one action stream per player, it generates each player's view of a shared world.
recipes.summaryZh: Gamma-World 是英伟达的多智能体世界模型：给定每个玩家的起始图像与各自的动作流，为每个玩家生成共享世界中的视角画面。它以原生扩散配方运行，含双向、因果与四步因果三个 variant；四步因果模型是默认的流式选择。

recipes.name: GEN3C
recipes.summary: GEN3C generates camera-controlled video with an explicit 3D cache: it builds a rough 3D scene from the input image (via depth), warps it along the requested camera path, and lets the video model fill in the rest — precise camera control…
recipes.summaryZh: GEN3C 用显式 3D 缓存生成相机可控视频：先从输入图（借助深度）搭出粗略 3D 场景，沿目标相机路径前向扭曲，再让视频模型补全其余部分——兼顾精确相机控制与 3D 一致性（CVPR 2025）。它原生运行在与 Cosmos Predict1 家族相同的去噪器、条件器与调度器栈上。

recipes.name: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5
recipes.summary: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5 is GigaAI's world-action policy: an action-centered Mixture-of-Transformers released as a pretrained initialization (Apache-2.0), riding on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B components for VAE, text encoder, and tokenizer.
recipes.summaryZh: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5 是极佳科技（GigaAI）的世界-动作策略：以动作为中心的 Mixture-of-Transformers，作为预训练初始化发布（Apache-2.0），VAE、文本编码器与 tokenizer 复用 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 组件。

recipes.name: Hailuo 2.3
recipes.summary: Hailuo 2.3 is MiniMax's hosted video generation service for image-to-video and joint audio-video generation.
recipes.summaryZh: Hailuo 2.3（海螺 2.3）是 MiniMax 的托管视频生成服务，支持图生视频与音视频联合生成。你提供一张起始图（可附文本提示词），MiniMax 在其基础设施上渲染成片；WorldFoundry 负责提交请求并回收返回的视频。别名 minimax-i2v、minimax_i2v 同样指向该模型。适合在不管理 GPU 的前提下，

recipes.name: Helios
recipes.summary: Helios is PKU-YuanGroup's long-video generation family covering T2V, I2V, V2V, and long-video generation, released in three checkpoints: Helios-Distilled (default, efficient), Helios-Mid, and Helios-Base (best quality).
recipes.summaryZh: Helios 是北大袁粒课题组的长视频生成系列，覆盖文生视频、图生视频、视频到视频与长视频生成，发布了三个 checkpoint：Helios-Distilled（默认、高效）、Helios-Mid、Helios-Base（最佳质量）。三个 checkpoint 均以 variant 形式提供。常驻的 Distilled 会话保留原生 9 潜变量/33 帧历史，并允许在分段之间更换提示词。

recipes.name: HelixWorld Preview v1
recipes.summary: HelixWorld Preview v1 generates camera-controlled video and spatial audio together from one image and three scene descriptions.
recipes.summaryZh: HelixWorld Preview v1 从一张图像及视觉、声音、联合场景描述生成相机可控视频与空间音频。

recipes.name: Hunyuan Game Craft
recipes.summary: Hunyuan GameCraft generates action-conditioned world video from a scene image: each action steers the next chunk of the rollout.
recipes.summaryZh: Hunyuan GameCraft 从场景图像生成动作条件的世界视频：每个动作驱动滚动生成的下一段。

recipes.name: HunyuanVideo
recipes.summary: HunyuanVideo is Tencent's large open video generation model, with T2V and I2V variants. WorldFoundry runs both as native diffusion recipes on the shared runner rather than through the upstream CLI.
recipes.summaryZh: HunyuanVideo 是腾讯的大规模开源视频生成模型，提供 T2V 与 I2V 两个 variant。WorldFoundry 用共享 runner 以原生扩散配方运行两者，不经过上游 CLI。

recipes.name: HunyuanVideo 1.5
recipes.summary: HunyuanVideo 1.5 is the newer revision of Tencent's open video family, with separate text-to-video and image-to-video variants.
recipes.summaryZh: HunyuanVideo 1.5 是腾讯开源视频系列的较新版本，提供独立的文生视频与图生视频变体。与初代不同，I2V 变体需要单独就位 gated 的 FLUX.1-Redux-dev 视觉 checkpoint。

recipes.name: HunyuanWorld-Voyager
recipes.summary: HunyuanWorld-Voyager generates RGB-D video along a camera path from an input image.
recipes.summaryZh: HunyuanWorld-Voyager 从输入图像出发，沿相机路径生成 RGB-D 视频。已在官方 case1 示例上验证：公开 runner 通过桥接已授权的上游源码，生成可完整解码的 45 帧 RGB-D 视频（768×1024，24 fps），上游默认的 50 步配置同样跑通。

recipes.name: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA
recipes.summary: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA is Tencent Hunyuan's bimanual manipulation VLA, released as two Apache-2.0 checkpoints on Hugging Face and ModelScope: RoboTwin and UMI.
recipes.summaryZh: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA 是腾讯混元的双臂操作 VLA，在 Hugging Face 与 ModelScope 上发布了两个 Apache-2.0 checkpoint：RoboTwin 与 UMI。已在 A100 上验证：RoboTwin checkpoint 从官方六帧三相机输入解码出 20x20 动作块，UMI checkpoint 以 BF16 解码出 50x20 相对动作块。

recipes.name: Hy-Nomas
recipes.summary: Segment-autoregressive text and camera controlled world generation with the distilled Hy-Nomas DiT and PixelUMM decoder.
recipes.summaryZh: 基于蒸馏 Hy-Nomas DiT 与 PixelUMM 解码器的文本和相机控制分段自回归世界生成。

recipes.name: HyDRA
recipes.summary: HyDRA is a camera-controlled video-to-video world model: it re-renders an input video along new camera behavior described by a camera JSON. Validated on the official example: a 50-step run generates a coherent 77-frame 832x480 continuation.
recipes.summaryZh: HyDRA 是相机可控的视频到视频世界模型：按 camera JSON 描述的新相机行为重新渲染输入视频。已在官方样例上验证：50 步推理生成了连贯的 77 帧 832x480 续写。

recipes.name: HyperFlow for MiniMax-H3
recipes.summary: Eight-step MiniMax-H3 adapter with joint video/audio, first/last-frame conditioning and ordered multimodal references.
recipes.summaryZh: MiniMax-H3 的八步推理适配器，支持联合音视频、首尾帧条件与有序多模态参考。

recipes.name: I2VGen-XL
recipes.summary: I2VGen-XL is Alibaba's cascaded image-to-video model, one of the earlier high-resolution open I2V releases. It turns a still image and a text prompt into a short video through a two-stage generate-then-refine cascade.
recipes.summaryZh: I2VGen-XL 是阿里巴巴的级联式图生视频模型，属较早的高分辨率开源 I2V 发布。它通过「先生成、再细化」的两级级联，把一张静态图和一段文本提示词生成为短视频。

recipes.name: JoyAI-Echo 1.5 / Echo-LongVideo
recipes.summary: JoyAI-Echo 1.5 is an inference-only long-form audio-video generator. Its R2V request can combine a prompt, an optional first frame, and as many as seven ordered image/audio memory slots so identity, voice, and story context persist across…
recipes.summaryZh: JoyAI-Echo 1.5 是仅推理的长时程音视频生成模型。R2V 请求可组合提示词、可选首帧与最多七个有序图像/音频记忆槽，使角色身份、声音与故事上下文在可独立编辑的镜头间延续。

recipes.name: Kandinsky 6.0 lite
recipes.summary: Native audio-video inference; checkpoint-backed CUDA parity is pending.
recipes.summaryZh: Kandinsky 6.0 lite 是来自 kandinskylab 的视频生成模型，支持文生视频、图生视频、音视频联合生成。

recipes.name: Kandinsky 6.0 lite-distill
recipes.summary: Native audio-video inference; checkpoint-backed CUDA parity is pending.
recipes.summaryZh: Kandinsky 6.0 lite-distill 是来自 kandinskylab 的视频生成模型，支持文生视频、图生视频、音视频联合生成。

recipes.name: Kandinsky 6.0 lite-pretrain
recipes.summary: Native audio-video inference; checkpoint-backed CUDA parity is pending.
recipes.summaryZh: Kandinsky 6.0 lite-pretrain 是来自 kandinskylab 的视频生成模型，支持文生视频、图生视频、音视频联合生成。

recipes.name: Kandinsky 6.0 pro
recipes.summary: Native audio-video inference; checkpoint-backed CUDA parity is pending.
recipes.summaryZh: Kandinsky 6.0 pro 是来自 kandinskylab 的视频生成模型，支持文生视频、图生视频、音视频联合生成。

recipes.name: Kandinsky 6.0 pro-distill
recipes.summary: Kandinsky 6.0 Pro-distill generates synchronized video and 44.1 kHz audio from text, with optional first-frame image conditioning. WorldFoundry runs the Pro transformer with 10 PiFlow steps through its native diffusion components.
recipes.summaryZh: Kandinsky 6.0 Pro-distill 根据文本生成同步视频和 44.1 kHz 音频，并支持可选的首帧图像条件。

recipes.name: Kandinsky 6.0 pro-pretrain
recipes.summary: Native audio-video inference; checkpoint-backed CUDA parity is pending.
recipes.summaryZh: Kandinsky 6.0 pro-pretrain 是来自 kandinskylab 的视频生成模型，支持文生视频、图生视频、音视频联合生成。

recipes.name: Kling API
recipes.summary: Kling API is the hosted endpoint for Kuaishou's Kling video generation family, covering text-to-video and image-to-video.
recipes.summaryZh: Kling API 是快手「可灵」视频生成系列的托管接入点，覆盖文生视频与图生视频。提示词或参考图会提交到快手的服务端，渲染好的视频以 WorldFoundry 产物的形式返回。托管的可灵结果与本地运行的开源模型共用同一套 Studio 结果格式，方便直接对比。

recipes.name: Krea Realtime Video 14B
recipes.summary: Krea Realtime Video 14B is Krea AI's open realtime/streaming video generation model. Unlike batch T2V models, it targets low-latency streaming generation: text-to-video and video-to-video in a streaming regime.
recipes.summaryZh: Krea Realtime Video 14B 是 Krea AI 开源的实时/流式视频生成模型。与批式 T2V 模型不同，它面向低延迟流式生成：以流式方式做文生视频与视频到视频。路径暴露 num_blocks、分辨率、fps 与 seed 控制。别名 krea-rt-14b 解析到该模型。

recipes.name: LagrNVS
recipes.summary: LagrNVS is Meta's novel-view-synthesis model for rendering new camera paths through a scene (facebook/lagernvs_general_512). WorldFoundry runs the upstream minimal_inference.py command through an in-tree adapter.
recipes.summaryZh: LagrNVS 是 Meta 的新视角合成模型，用于沿新的相机路径渲染场景（facebook/lagernvs_general_512）。

recipes.name: LaST-R1
recipes.summary: LaST-R1 is an MIT-licensed VLA policy. WorldFoundry integrates offline image-and-instruction inference through its model-specific latent/action-token adapter.
recipes.summaryZh: LaST-R1 是 MIT 许可的 VLA 策略。WorldFoundry 已通过模型专用 latent/action-token 适配器接入离线图像与指令推理。

recipes.name: LingBot-Map
recipes.providerZh: 蚂蚁灵波科技（Robbyant，蚂蚁集团）
recipes.summary: LingBot-Map is Robbyant's streaming 3D reconstruction model: it consumes image streams and produces camera poses, depth, and point clouds through the GCTStream runtime, supporting both streaming and windowed reconstruction via…
recipes.summaryZh: LingBot-Map 是蚂蚁灵波的流式 3D 重建模型：通过 GCTStream 运行时消费图像流，产出相机位姿、深度与点云，LingBotMapPipeline 同时支持流式与窗口式重建。

recipes.name: LingBot-Video
recipes.providerZh: 蚂蚁灵波科技（Robbyant，蚂蚁集团）
recipes.summary: LingBot-Video is Robbyant's video generation family for text-to-image, text-to-video, text+image-to-video, and video refinement. It comes in two checkpoint lines: a dense 1.3B model and a MoE 30B-A3B model that ships with a refiner.
recipes.summaryZh: LingBot-Video 是蚂蚁灵波（Robbyant）的视频生成系列，支持文生图、文生视频、图文生视频与视频细化。它有两条 checkpoint 线：稠密 1.3B 模型与带细化器的 MoE 30B-A3B 模型。

recipes.name: LingBot-World Base Act
recipes.providerZh: 蚂蚁灵波科技（Robbyant，蚂蚁集团）
recipes.summary: LingBot-World Base Act is the action-conditioned sibling of LingBot-World: instead of camera poses it consumes an action matrix, making it the interactive-control profile of the family.
recipes.summaryZh: LingBot-World Base Act 是 LingBot-World 的动作条件同门：它消费动作矩阵而非相机位姿，是该家族的交互控制档案。它加载官方 Base-Act 预览 checkpoint，而不是 Base-Cam。

recipes.name: LingBot-World-V2
recipes.providerZh: 蚂蚁灵波科技（Robbyant，蚂蚁集团）
recipes.summary: LingBot-World-V2 (also aliased lingbot-world-infinity) is the second generation of Robbyant's world model: a 14B causal-fast model for image-to-world video with camera control.
recipes.summaryZh: LingBot-World-V2（别名 lingbot-world-infinity）是蚂蚁灵波世界模型的第二代：14B causal-fast 模型，用于带相机控制的图到世界视频。已用发布权重验证：causal-fast 路径可在单张 80 GB GPU 上生成可解码的 9 帧 848x464、16 FPS 视频。

recipes.name: LingBot-World-V2 1.3B
recipes.providerZh: 蚂蚁灵波科技（Robbyant，蚂蚁集团）
recipes.summary: LingBot-World-V2 1.3B is Robbyant's causal-fast camera-controlled world model, a smaller sibling of the 14B lingbot-world-v2 with its own checkpoint and defaults.
recipes.summaryZh: LingBot-World-V2 1.3B 是 Robbyant 的 causal-fast 相机控制世界模型，是 14B lingbot-world-v2 的小规模版本，拥有独立的 checkpoint 与默认配置。

recipes.name: LiveWorld
recipes.summary: LiveWorld is a camera-controlled video-to-video world model with a monitor-centric workflow: it consumes a video plus a geometry NPZ and re-renders the scene under new camera behavior.
recipes.summaryZh: LiveWorld 是相机可控的视频到视频世界模型，采用以监控画面为中心的工作流：输入视频加几何 NPZ，在新的相机行为下重新渲染场景。WorldFoundry 以官方源码运行，并提供专用的几何 NPZ 输入路径。

recipes.name: LongCat-Video
recipes.summary: LongCat-Video is Meituan's open video generation model focused on long-video generation: text-to-video, image-to-video, and native video continuation in one model.
recipes.summaryZh: LongCat-Video 是美团开源的视频生成模型，主打长视频：文生视频、图生视频与原生视频续写集于一个模型。pipeline 运行官方 demo 脚本，只有显式传入 execute=True 才会执行。权重为 MIT 许可，位于 meituan-longcat/LongCat-Video。

recipes.name: LongVie
recipes.providerZh: 上海人工智能实验室（Vchitect 团队）
recipes.summary: LongVie is a controllable ultra-long video generation framework from the Vchitect team: it drives a Wan-based diffusion backbone with dense depth and sparse point/track control videos to keep minute-scale videos consistent.
recipes.summaryZh: LongVie 是 Vchitect 团队的可控超长视频生成框架：用稠密深度与稀疏点/轨迹控制视频来驱动基于 Wan 的扩散基座，使分钟级视频保持一致。longvie-1 是第一代适配器；上游尚未发布第一代权重，公开的 Vchitect/LongVie2 checkpoint 不能混用。

recipes.name: LTX-2.5 Distilled
recipes.summary: LTX-2.5 is a 22B joint audio-video model. WorldFoundry runs the official fast two-stage DistilledPipeline (inference only) for text-to-video and image-to-video, including synchronized audio generation.
recipes.summaryZh: LTX-2.5 是一个 22B 联合音视频模型。WorldFoundry 运行官方快速两阶段 DistilledPipeline（仅推理），支持文生视频、图生视频与同步音频生成。

recipes.name: LTX-2.x
recipes.summary: LTX-2.x is Lightricks' current video model family. WorldFoundry provides native distilled I2V routes and official IC-LoRA control-video routes for LTX-2 and LTX-2.3.
recipes.summaryZh: LTX-2.x 是 Lightricks 当前的视频模型系列。WorldFoundry 提供原生蒸馏版 I2V 路径，以及 LTX-2 和 LTX-2.3 的官方 IC-LoRA 控制视频路径。两条 I2V 路径均能生成 demo 视频；V2V 仅在小尺寸合成控制输入上运行过。

recipes.name: LTX-Video
recipes.summary: LTX-Video is Lightricks' earlier fast video generation model. WorldFoundry runs its 0.9.8 distilled image-to-video route natively; like LTX-2.x it runs a two-stage denoise with the official spatial upscaler in between.
recipes.summaryZh: LTX-Video 是 Lightricks 较早的高速视频生成模型。WorldFoundry 原生运行其 0.9.8 蒸馏图生视频路径；与 LTX-2.x 一样采用两段去噪，中间接官方空间上采样器。唯一可运行的 variant 是 ltx-video-i2v；系列级的文生视频标签描述的是上游能力。

recipes.name: Luma Ray2
recipes.summary: Luma Ray2 is Luma AI's hosted video generation model for text-to-video and image-to-video.
recipes.summaryZh: Luma Ray2 是 Luma AI 的托管视频生成模型，支持文生视频与图生视频。WorldFoundry 的 Studio pipeline 封装了 Luma API：一条提示词或一帧起始图，最终以标准 WorldFoundry 结果目录中的可下载视频呈现。模型在 Luma 的服务器上运行，不在本地运行。

recipes.name: MAGI-1
recipes.summary: MAGI-1 is Sand AI's open autoregressive video generation model for image-to-video and general video generation, released under Apache-2.0.
recipes.summaryZh: MAGI-1 是 Sand AI 开源的自回归视频生成模型，用于图生视频与通用视频生成，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。

recipes.name: MAGI-2 Preview
recipes.summary: 114B-parameter MoE (256 experts, top-6), ~6B active per token; 10-second preview video at 12.5 fps with 44.1kHz audio.
recipes.summaryZh: MAGI-2 Preview 是来自 sand-ai 的视频生成模型，支持文生视频。

recipes.name: MagicWorld
recipes.summary: MagicWorld is vivo's interactive world model: from an image it generates camera-controlled world video through the MagicWorld-Fast camera path.
recipes.summaryZh: MagicWorld 是 vivo 的交互式世界模型：从一张图经 MagicWorld-Fast 相机路径生成相机可控的世界视频。

recipes.name: Matrix-Game 1.0
recipes.summary: Matrix-Game 1.0 is the first generation of Skywork's interactive game world model: from an image and keyboard/mouse-style actions it generates playable game-world video.
recipes.summaryZh: Matrix-Game 1.0 是昆仑万维交互式游戏世界模型的第一代：从一张图与键鼠式动作生成可交互的游戏世界视频。它有独立的模型 id，运行官方 Matrix-Game 1 运行时，而不是 Matrix-Game 2 的运行时。

recipes.name: Matrix-Game 3.5
recipes.summary: Matrix-Game 3.5 First-Person Base is the first-person profile of the Matrix-Game 3.5 release: long-horizon interactive world video at 1280x704, generated block by block (84 new frames per block) under camera-NPZ control.
recipes.summaryZh: Matrix-Game 3.5 First-Person Base 是 Matrix-Game 3.5 发布的第一人称档案：在 camera NPZ 控制下逐块（每块新增 84 帧）生成 1280x704 的长时程交互世界视频。该模型 id 固定加载 first-person.safetensors 权重。

recipes.name: Matrix-Game 4 Ancient Egypt
recipes.summary: A low-poly game video is re-rendered as an Ancient Egypt scene by a causal video diffusion model. The native model can run without the optional upstream game engine.
recipes.summaryZh: 因果视频扩散模型把低模游戏视频重渲染为古埃及场景。原生模型可以独立于可选的上游游戏引擎运行。

recipes.name: MiniMax H3
recipes.summary: Joint audio+video generation; 32kHz stereo audio track muxed into the mp4.
recipes.summaryZh: MiniMax H3 是来自 MiniMaxAI 的视频生成模型，支持文生视频、图生视频、参考图生成视频。

recipes.name: minWM
recipes.summary: minWM HY Action2V generates camera-controlled video from a prompt, image and trajectory on a HunyuanVideo-1.5 base.
recipes.summaryZh: minWM HY Action2V 基于 HunyuanVideo-1.5，从提示词、图像和轨迹生成相机可控视频。

recipes.name: MIRA
recipes.summary: MIRA is a multiplayer interactive world model: several players act in one shared, action-conditioned generated world (paper arXiv 2607.05352).
recipes.summaryZh: MIRA 是多人交互世界模型：多名玩家在同一个动作条件生成世界中行动（论文 arXiv 2607.05352）。WorldFoundry 仅支持推理，需要兼容的本地 checkpoint 与包含 index.json 的本地 Rocket Science 数据集切分。

recipes.name: MMAudio
recipes.provider: Sony AI / University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
recipes.providerZh: 索尼 AI / 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校
recipes.summary: MMAudio generates soundtracks for silent video: given a video (and optionally a text prompt), it synthesizes audio that is semantically and temporally aligned with the visuals.
recipes.summaryZh: MMAudio 为无声视频生成配音：给定一段视频（可附文本提示词），它合成与画面语义和时间对齐的音频。可用它为视频模型生成的片段补配音；产物类型是 generated_audio，而非视频。

recipes.name: Mochi-1
recipes.summary: Mochi-1 is Genmo's open text-to-video model, released as a preview checkpoint and known for strong motion quality among open models at its release.
recipes.summaryZh: Mochi-1 是 Genmo 开源的文生视频模型，以 preview checkpoint 形式发布，发布时在开源模型中以运动质量见长。WorldFoundry 以 mochi-1-preview-t2v variant 运行官方 preview checkpoint。

recipes.name: ModelScopeT2V
recipes.summary: ModelScopeT2V is Alibaba DAMO Academy's original open text-to-video diffusion model — the 1.7B model that kicked off much of the open T2V ecosystem (ZeroScope is a fine-tune of it). It serves mainly as a historical baseline.
recipes.summaryZh: ModelScopeT2V 是阿里达摩院最早开源的文生视频扩散模型，即带动了开源 T2V 生态的 1.7B 模型（ZeroScope 就是它的微调版）。它主要作为历史基线使用。

recipes.name: MolmoBot
recipes.summary: MolmoBot is AI2's robot policy family around the Molmo VLM, with Apache-2.0 checkpoints for Franka DROID, image-conditioned DROID, and RBY1 multitask; the Pi0-based DROID checkpoint is Gemma-licensed.
recipes.summaryZh: MolmoBot 是 AI2 围绕 Molmo VLM 的机器人策略家族。Franka DROID、图像条件 DROID 和 RBY1 多任务 checkpoint 采用 Apache-2.0；基于 Pi0 的 DROID checkpoint 标注为 Gemma 许可。WorldFoundry 支持两条动作推理路径。

recipes.name: MultiWorld
recipes.summary: MultiWorld ("It Takes Two") is a multi-agent interactive video generator: two players' actions drive one shared generated game world. WorldFoundry runs the ItTakesTwo variant in-tree with local checkpoints.
recipes.summaryZh: MultiWorld（「It Takes Two」）是多智能体交互视频生成器：两名玩家的动作驱动同一个共享生成游戏世界。

recipes.name: MVDiffusion
recipes.providerZh: 西蒙菲莎大学（Simon Fraser University）
recipes.summary: MVDiffusion generates multi-view images and panoramas with correspondence-aware attention.
recipes.summaryZh: MVDiffusion 利用对应感知注意力生成多视角图像和全景。
aliases: MVDiffusion: Enabling Holistic Multi-view Image Generation
tasks: correspondence-aware multiview image generation and scene texturing
tasksZh: 对应感知多视图图像生成与场景纹理化

recipes.name: NVIDIA DreamZero
recipes.summary: NVIDIA DreamZero is a world-action model (WAM) that couples video prediction with robot control: DROID and AgiBot checkpoints are released under Apache-2.0 (GEAR-Dreams org).
recipes.summaryZh: 英伟达 DreamZero 是将视频预测与机器人控制耦合的世界-动作模型（WAM）：DROID 与 AgiBot checkpoint 以 Apache-2.0 发布（GEAR-Dreams 组织）。

recipes.name: NVIDIA GR00T
recipes.summary: NVIDIA GR00T is the Isaac GR00T humanoid/manipulation foundation policy line (N1 through N1.7).
recipes.summaryZh: 英伟达 GR00T 是 Isaac GR00T 人形/操作基础策略线（N1 至 N1.7）。WorldFoundry 对初代 N1 使用基于固定官方源码的隔离进程，对 N1.7 使用树内运行时；两类权重均可在 GPU 上生成离线动作。

recipes.name: Octo
recipes.providerZh: 加州大学伯克利分校（RAIL 实验室）
recipes.summary: Octo is Berkeley RAIL's generalist robot policy trained on Open X-Embodiment data, released as octo-base-1.5 and octo-small-1.5 with pinned revisions.
recipes.summaryZh: Octo 是伯克利 RAIL 在 Open X-Embodiment 数据上训练的通用机器人策略，发布 octo-base-1.5 与 octo-small-1.5 并锁定 revision。已在 A100 上用官方 octo-small-1.5 checkpoint 验证：Orbax 树可恢复（1.367 亿参数），sample_actions 返回有限的 (1, 4, 7) 动作块。

recipes.name: OmniVinci
recipes.summary: OmniVinci is NVIDIA's omni-modal understanding LLM: one model that reasons over images, video, and audio together.
recipes.summaryZh: OmniVinci 是英伟达的全模态理解大模型：单一模型同时对图像、视频与音频进行推理。它用于回答问题而非生成内容：任务为多模态推理、音频推理与图像/视频问答，产物是 model_response。

recipes.name: Open-MAGVIT2
recipes.summary: Open-MAGVIT2 is Tencent ARC's open reproduction of the MAGVIT-v2 lookup-free visual tokenizer, plus autoregressive generation on top of it.
recipes.summaryZh: Open-MAGVIT2 是腾讯 ARC 对 MAGVIT-v2 免查表（lookup-free）视觉分词器的开源复现，并在其上构建自回归生成。WorldFoundry 运行其 ImageNet 类条件图像生成路径：256 token 生成产出 256x256 的 PNG 图像，而非视频。已用发布的 checkpoint 验证：生成 ImageNet 类别 207 得到语义正确的图像。

recipes.name: Open-Sora
recipes.summary: Open-Sora is HPC-AI Tech's fully open text-to-video project — model, training code, and data pipeline are all published, which made it a popular reproducible baseline.
recipes.summaryZh: Open-Sora 是潞晨科技（HPC-AI Tech）的全开源文生视频项目，模型、训练代码与数据管线全部公开，因此成为流行的可复现基线。WorldFoundry 运行 v1.2 STDiT-v3 推理路径，需要模型与 VAE 两个独立仓库。

recipes.name: Open-Sora-Plan
recipes.summary: Open-Sora-Plan is Peking University Yuan Group's open text-to-video effort (HF releases under the LanguageBind org), developed independently from HPC-AI Tech's Open-Sora despite the similar name. WorldFoundry runs the v1.3.0 GPU release.
recipes.summaryZh: Open-Sora-Plan 是北京大学袁粒课题组的开源文生视频项目（HF 发布在 LanguageBind 组织下），虽与潞晨的 Open-Sora 同名相近，但相互独立。WorldFoundry 运行 v1.3.0 GPU 版本。

recipes.name: OpenPI
recipes.summary: OpenPI is Physical Intelligence's official open-source release of the pi-series robot policies (Apache-2.0). Validated with the released checkpoint: pi05_libero policy inference runs end to end and emits the configured action schema.
recipes.summaryZh: OpenPI 是 Physical Intelligence 官方开源的 pi 系列机器人策略（Apache-2.0）。已用发布的 checkpoint 验证：pi05_libero 策略推理可端到端运行，并输出配置的动作 schema。

recipes.name: Pika H3 Flex
recipes.summary: Six-step MiniMax-H3 adapter for joint video/audio generation with endpoint and multimodal image references.
recipes.summaryZh: 基于 MiniMax-H3 的六步联合音视频适配器，支持首尾帧与多模态图像参考。

recipes.name: pixelSplat
recipes.summary: pixelSplat reconstructs a 3D Gaussian scene from two calibrated views in a single forward pass (CVPR 2024).
recipes.summaryZh: pixelSplat 在单次前向中从两张标定视图重建 3D 高斯场景（CVPR 2024）。树内运行时支持原始卷积版本的 RE10K 和 ACID 权重，已使用真实标定输入完成 GPU 验证。

recipes.name: Pusa VidGen
recipes.summary: Pusa VidGen (Pusa V1) demonstrates vectorized timestep adaptation: instead of one shared diffusion timestep for the whole video, each frame gets its own, which unlocks image-to-video, text-to-video, and video extension from one cheap LoRA…
recipes.summaryZh: Pusa VidGen（Pusa V1）展示了向量化时间步适配：不再让整段视频共享一个扩散时间步，而是每帧独立时间步，从而用一次低成本的 Wan2.2 LoRA 训练同时解锁图生视频、文生视频与视频延展。WorldFoundry 完全用规范化 Wan2.2 组件装配它——推理时不需要外部运行时检出。

recipes.name: Qwen2.5-Omni
recipes.providerZh: 阿里巴巴（通义千问 Qwen）
recipes.summary: Qwen2.5-Omni is Alibaba's end-to-end omni-modal model: it perceives text, images, audio, and video.
recipes.summaryZh: Qwen2.5-Omni 是阿里的端到端全模态模型：能感知文本、图像、音频与视频。WorldFoundry 用它做理解与推理——多模态推理、音频推理与图像/视频问答——产物为 model_response。支持的权重是 7B 版本（Qwen/Qwen2.5-Omni-7B）。

recipes.name: RISE
recipes.summary: RISE from OpenDriveLab is a Pi0.5-architecture action policy (Apache-2.0). The in-tree runtime runs the official deployment transform, three-camera mapping, Pi0.5 action architecture, normalization, and the 50x14 action output in process.
recipes.summaryZh: OpenDriveLab 的 RISE 是 Pi0.5 架构的动作策略（Apache-2.0）。树内运行时在进程内执行官方部署变换、三相机映射、Pi0.5 动作架构、归一化与 50x14 动作输出。公开的 OpenDriveLab-org/RISE_Assets 仓库只提供动力学模型与样例数据，不含训练好的动作策略 checkpoint。

recipes.name: RollingForcing
recipes.providerZh: 腾讯（ARC Lab）/ 南洋理工大学
recipes.summary: RollingForcing streams minutes-long video autoregressively: rolling-window denoising with an attention sink lets it generate long text-to-video without the drift that kills naive streaming (paper arXiv 2509.25161).
recipes.summaryZh: RollingForcing 自回归地流式生成数分钟长的视频：滚动窗口去噪加 attention sink，避免了朴素流式生成的漂移崩坏（论文 arXiv 2509.25161）。已在 A100 上用发布的 checkpoint 验证：126 个潜帧解码为 31.31 秒的 H.264 视频（501 帧，832x480，16 fps）。

recipes.name: Runway Gen-4.5
recipes.summary: Runway Gen-4.5 is Runway's hosted image-to-video model. Give it a start image and it returns an animated clip generated on Runway's service. The aliases gen_3_i2v and gen-3-i2v also resolve to this model.
recipes.summaryZh: Runway Gen-4.5 是 Runway 的托管图生视频模型。提供一张起始图，它在 Runway 服务端生成动态视频。别名 gen_3_i2v、gen-3-i2v 也解析到该模型。结果经与本地模型一致的 Studio pipeline 返回，产物格式相同。

recipes.name: SAMA
recipes.summary: SAMA 14B is an open instruction-guided video editing model: it takes a source video and a text instruction. The released inference route does not accept a spatial mask or separate reference image. Weights are apache-2.0 at syxbb/SAMA-14B.
recipes.summaryZh: SAMA 14B 是开源的指令引导视频编辑模型，输入是源视频和文本指令。发布的推理入口不接受空间蒙版或单独的参考图。权重位于 syxbb/SAMA-14B，采用 apache-2.0 许可证。

recipes.name: SANA-WM
recipes.summary: SANA-WM is a world model built on NVIDIA's efficient Sana architecture: a two-stage design (interactive stage plus LTX-2 refiner) that generates camera-controlled world video with a resident multi-GPU pipeline.
recipes.summaryZh: SANA-WM 是基于英伟达高效 Sana 架构的世界模型：两阶段设计（交互阶段加 LTX-2 精修器），以常驻多卡 pipeline 生成相机可控的世界视频。已在四张 A100 上验证：一次短运行从九帧原生窗口生成八帧可解码的 1280x704 画面。

recipes.name: Segment and Track Anything
recipes.summary: Segment and Track Anything (SAM-Track) combines SAM segmentation with AOT/DeAOT tracking so objects can be segmented once and tracked across a whole video, with GroundingDINO enabling text-prompted selection.
recipes.summaryZh: Segment and Track Anything（SAM-Track）把 SAM 分割与 AOT/DeAOT 跟踪结合起来：对象只需分割一次即可在整段视频中被跟踪，GroundingDINO 支持文本提示选择。

recipes.name: Self-Forcing
recipes.provider: Adobe Research / The University of Texas at Austin
recipes.providerZh: Adobe 研究院 / 得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校
recipes.summary: Self-Forcing bridges the train-test gap in autoregressive video diffusion: by simulating the inference process during training — conditioning each frame on its own previously generated frames — it enables real-time streaming text-to-video…
recipes.summaryZh: Self-Forcing 弥合了自回归视频扩散的训练-推理差距：在训练时模拟推理过程——让每帧以自己先前生成的帧为条件——从而在单卡上实现实时流式文生视频（arXiv 2506.08009）。WorldFoundry 运行官方仅推理运行时，需要 Self-Forcing DMD checkpoint 与 Wan2.1 权重。

recipes.name: SkyReels V3
recipes.summary: SkyReels V3 is Skywork's newer generation, covering reference-to-video, audio-guided video, and video-to-video.
recipes.summaryZh: SkyReels V3 是 Skywork 的更新一代，覆盖参考图生视频、音频引导视频与视频到视频。

recipes.name: SkyReels-V2
recipes.summary: SkyReels-V2 is Skywork AI's open film-generation model family built on the Wan architecture, covering text-to-video and image-to-video.
recipes.summaryZh: SkyReels-V2 是昆仑万维 Skywork AI 基于 Wan 架构的开源影视生成模型系列，覆盖文生视频与图生视频。WorldFoundry 用共享的原生 Wan 图、条件器、VAE、调度器与加载器运行其 1.3B 模型。

recipes.name: SolarWM
recipes.summary: SolarWM provides dataset-indexed camera-controlled inference across Wan 5B/14B, LTX-2.5 and MiniMax-H3 releases.
recipes.summaryZh: SolarWM 支持从数据索引读取相机轨迹，在 Wan 5B/14B、LTX-2.5 和 MiniMax-H3 路线上执行推理。

recipes.name: Sora2
recipes.summary: Sora2 runs OpenAI's Sora 2 hosted video model for text-to-video and image-to-video.
recipes.summaryZh: Sora2 调用 OpenAI 的 Sora 2 托管视频模型，支持文生视频与图生视频。提示词提交给 OpenAI 的 API，生成的视频以标准 WorldFoundry 产物保存，因此 Sora 2 的输出可以用与本地模型相同的工具链评测。Sora 无法在本地运行，仅支持托管 API。

recipes.name: Spatia
recipes.summary: Spatia is a camera-controlled video-to-video world model: given source video and a target camera trajectory it re-renders the scene along the new viewpoint path.
recipes.summaryZh: Spatia 是相机控制的 video-to-video 世界模型：给定源视频与目标相机轨迹，沿新视角路径重新渲染场景。WorldFoundry 自带官方源码，加载以 Apache-2.0 许可发布的 Jinjing713/Spatia checkpoint。

recipes.name: SpatialLadder
recipes.summary: SpatialLadder is a 3B multimodal model specialized in spatial reasoning: it answers questions about spatial relations in images and videos and returns a model_response artifact. Weights: hongxingli/SpatialLadder-3B.
recipes.summaryZh: SpatialLadder 是专精空间推理的 3B 多模态模型：回答图像与视频中空间关系相关的问题，产出 model_response 产物。权重：hongxingli/SpatialLadder-3B。

recipes.name: SpatialReasoner
recipes.providerZh: 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学（CCVL 实验室）
recipes.summary: SpatialReasoner is a vision-language model from the JHU CCVL group focused on explicit, step-wise spatial reasoning over images and video. It handles spatial and multimodal reasoning plus image/video QA and returns model_response artifacts.
recipes.summaryZh: SpatialReasoner 是约翰斯·霍普金斯大学 CCVL 组的视觉-语言模型，专注对图像与视频进行显式、分步的空间推理。它支持空间与多模态推理以及图像/视频问答，返回 model_response 产物。

recipes.name: Stable Video Infinity 2.0
recipes.providerZh: 洛桑联邦理工学院（EPFL VITA 实验室）
recipes.summary: Stable Video Infinity 2.0 (SVI) generates arbitrarily long videos by chaining clips with five-frame continuation and per-clip seed changes, driven by prompt streams.
recipes.summaryZh: Stable Video Infinity 2.0（SVI）通过五帧续接与逐段换种子来串联视频段，由提示词流驱动，可生成任意长度的视频。已在 A100 上以默认设置验证：两段相接的 81 帧 832x544 视频组成 157 帧 H.264 视频，与官方运行时在相同设置下对比达到 31.03 dB PSNR。

recipes.name: Stable Virtual Camera
recipes.summary: Stable Virtual Camera (SEVA) turns one or a few 2D images into a novel-view video along a user-defined camera path. WorldFoundry wraps the upstream demo.py entrypoint with an in-tree adapter; the Stability AI checkpoint is gated.
recipes.summaryZh: Stable Virtual Camera（SEVA）把一张或几张 2D 图像变成沿用户自定义相机路径的新视角视频。WorldFoundry 用树内适配器封装上游 demo.py 入口；Stability AI checkpoint 为 gated。
tasks: generative novel view synthesis with camera control
tasksZh: 相机可控生成式新视角合成

recipes.name: T2V Turbo T2V
recipes.providerZh: 加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校（UCSB）
recipes.summary: T2V-Turbo is a fast text-to-video model distilled from VideoCrafter2 with consistency distillation plus reward feedback, generating watchable clips in 4-8 steps.
recipes.summaryZh: T2V-Turbo 是从 VideoCrafter2 蒸馏出的快速文生视频模型，结合一致性蒸馏与奖励反馈，4-8 步即可生成可看的视频。

recipes.name: TinyVLA
recipes.summary: TinyVLA targets fast, data-efficient VLA at sub-billion scale: LLaVA-Pythia backbones (400M / 700M / 1.3B released on the Hub) with ACT or conditional 1D-diffusion action heads.
recipes.summaryZh: TinyVLA 追求亚十亿级的快速、数据高效 VLA：LLaVA-Pythia 骨干（Hub 上发布 400M / 700M / 1.3B）配 ACT 或条件 1D 扩散动作头。Hub 上发布的模型是用于策略训练的 VLM 骨干——并非任务训练好的机器人 checkpoint——因此运行前需自行准备训练好的任务策略。

recipes.name: UniAnimate-DiT
recipes.summary: UniAnimate-DiT is Alibaba ali-vilab's human image animation model built on Wan2.1-I2V: it animates a person photo to follow a driving pose sequence.
recipes.summaryZh: UniAnimate-DiT 是阿里 ali-vilab 基于 Wan2.1-I2V 的人物图像动画模型：让人物照片按驱动姿态序列动起来。树内路径使用本地 checkpoint 资产运行，暴露 max_frames、分辨率、步数与 seed 控制。

recipes.name: UniDepth V2
recipes.providerZh: 苏黎世联邦理工学院（ETH Zurich）
recipes.summary: UniDepth V2 is a universal monocular metric-depth model: from a single image of any camera it predicts a metric 3D point cloud directly, without external intrinsics.
recipes.summaryZh: UniDepth V2 是通用单目米制深度模型：对任意相机的单张图像直接预测米制 3D 点云，无需外部内参。已用发布的 checkpoint 验证：推理与官方点云导出可通过几何先验 pipeline 运行。

recipes.name: UniK3D
recipes.providerZh: 苏黎世联邦理工学院（ETH Zurich）
recipes.summary: UniK3D generalizes metric 3D estimation to any camera — pinhole, fisheye, even full panoramas — with one model. WorldFoundry uses it as a universal-camera geometry prior.
recipes.summaryZh: UniK3D 把米制 3D 估计推广到任意相机——针孔、鱼眼、乃至完整全景——只用一个模型。WorldFoundry 将其用作通用相机几何先验。已用发布的 checkpoint 通过共享几何先验 pipeline 验证，支持自动相机估计；针孔与全景相机覆盖需显式设置。

recipes.name: UniWorld-View
recipes.summary: UniWorld-View generates camera-controlled novel views from a single image or a casually captured monocular video.
recipes.summaryZh: UniWorld-View 从单张图像或随手拍摄的单目视频生成相机可控的新视角视频。

recipes.name: Vchitect-2.0 T2V
recipes.providerZh: 上海人工智能实验室（Vchitect 团队）
recipes.summary: Vchitect-2.0 is Shanghai AI Lab's open text-to-video diffusion transformer. WorldFoundry runs its 2B checkpoint through a native implementation of the DiT and the SD3 decoder.
recipes.summaryZh: Vchitect-2.0 是上海人工智能实验室的开源文生视频扩散 Transformer。WorldFoundry 以原生实现的 DiT 与 SD3 解码器运行其 2B checkpoint。

notes: Hugging Face API reports gated=auto; accept access terms before downloading.

recipes.name: Veo3
recipes.summary: Veo3 is Google DeepMind's Veo 3 hosted video model for text-to-video and image-to-video.
recipes.summaryZh: Veo3 是 Google DeepMind 的 Veo 3 托管视频模型，支持文生视频与图生视频。

recipes.name: VerseCrafter
recipes.summary: VerseCrafter from Tencent ARC is a camera-controlled image-to-video world model built on 4D control: a geometry-aware rendering stage produces 4D control signals that guide the diffusion stage along the requested camera path.
recipes.summaryZh: 腾讯 ARC 的 VerseCrafter 是基于 4D 控制的相机可控图生视频世界模型：几何感知渲染阶段产出 4D 控制信号，引导扩散阶段沿指定相机路径生成。运行需要 TencentARC/VerseCrafter checkpoint，以及 Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-14B 与 Ruicheng/moge-2-vitl-normal。

recipes.name: Video Depth Anything
recipes.summary: Video Depth Anything brings temporal consistency to the Depth Anything family: it estimates depth over arbitrarily long videos without the flicker of frame-by-frame estimation.
recipes.summaryZh: Video Depth Anything 为 Depth Anything 家族带来时序一致性：在任意长度的视频上估计深度，避免逐帧估计的闪烁。

recipes.name: VideoCrafter
recipes.summary: VideoCrafter is Tencent AI Lab's open video generation toolbox. The family groups the in-tree infer-only runtimes for VideoCrafter1 I2V, VideoCrafter1 T2V, and VideoCrafter2 T2V; each route also has its own model page (videocrafter1-i2v…
recipes.summaryZh: VideoCrafter 是腾讯 AI Lab 的开源视频生成工具箱。该系列包含 VideoCrafter1 I2V、VideoCrafter1 T2V 与 VideoCrafter2 T2V 的树内仅推理运行时；每条路径也有独立的模型页（videocrafter1-i2v、videocrafter1-t2v、videocrafter2-t2v）。

recipes.name: VideoCrafter1 I2V
recipes.summary: VideoCrafter1 I2V is the image-to-video member of Tencent AI Lab's VideoCrafter1 release: it animates a still image while preserving its content, style, and structure.
recipes.summaryZh: VideoCrafter1 I2V 是腾讯 AI Lab VideoCrafter1 发布中的图生视频成员：在保持内容、风格与结构的前提下让静态图动起来。树内仅推理运行时封装官方路径，提供本地 checkpoint、fps、帧数与 seed 控制。

recipes.name: VideoCrafter1 T2V
recipes.summary: VideoCrafter1 T2V is the text-to-video member of the VideoCrafter1 release, generating clips up to 1024x576 from a prompt.
recipes.summaryZh: VideoCrafter1 T2V 是 VideoCrafter1 发布中的文生视频成员，按提示词生成最高 1024x576 的视频。WorldFoundry 以仅推理方式运行官方 1024 文生视频路径，提供本地 checkpoint、fps、帧数与 seed 控制。

recipes.name: VideoCrafter2 T2V
recipes.summary: VideoCrafter2 T2V is the improved text-to-video model of the VideoCrafter family, trained to overcome low-quality video data by combining it with high-quality image data.
recipes.summaryZh: VideoCrafter2 T2V 是 VideoCrafter 系列中改进版的文生视频模型，通过将低质量视频数据与高质量图像数据结合训练来突破数据瓶颈。它以 Apache-2.0 许可发布，是系列中许可最宽松的成员。WorldFoundry 仅支持推理，提供本地 checkpoint、fps、帧数与 seed 控制。

recipes.name: Wan 2.5 API
recipes.summary: Wan 2.5 API is the hosted DashScope endpoint for Alibaba's Wan 2.5 video generation model, for text-to-video and image-to-video.
recipes.summaryZh: Wan 2.5 API 是阿里巴巴通义万相 Wan 2.5 视频生成模型的 DashScope 托管接入点，支持文生视频与图生视频。与 WorldFoundry 本地运行的开源 Wan 权重不同，它走服务方托管的生成路径：请求发往阿里云 DashScope，成片以产物形式返回。别名 wan2.5、wan-2.5 同样解析到该模型。

recipes.name: Wan 2.6 API
recipes.summary: Wan 2.6 API is the DashScope-hosted image-to-video endpoint for Alibaba's Wan 2.6 model.
recipes.summaryZh: Wan 2.6 API 是阿里 Wan 2.6 模型的 DashScope 托管图生视频接入点。你提供起始图，阿里云返回渲染好的视频；WorldFoundry 按标准产物布局保存请求与结果。别名：wan2.6、wan-2.6。想在无本地 GPU 的情况下使用较新的托管 Wan 版本时选择它。

recipes.name: Wan 2.7 API
recipes.summary: Wan 2.7 API is Alibaba's DashScope-hosted Wan 2.7 endpoint for image-to-video. As with the Wan 2.5/2.6 APIs, WorldFoundry submits the start image to Alibaba Cloud and archives the returned clip; the aliases wan2.7 and wan-2.7 resolve to it.
recipes.summaryZh: Wan 2.7 API 是阿里云 DashScope 托管的 Wan 2.7 图生视频接入点。与 Wan 2.5/2.6 API 一样，WorldFoundry 把起始图提交给阿里云并归档返回的视频；别名 wan2.7、wan-2.7 同样指向它。实际服务的模型修订版由阿里控制。

recipes.name: Wan2.1 VACE
recipes.summary: Wan2.1 VACE is the all-in-one video creation and editing member of the Wan2.1 family: reference-image guidance, video-to-video editing, and mask/control-conditioned generation in one checkpoint.
recipes.summaryZh: Wan2.1 VACE 是 Wan2.1 系列中「创作与编辑一体」的成员：参考图引导、视频到视频编辑与掩码/控制条件生成集于一个 checkpoint。WorldFoundry 用标准 Wan 组件装配它，支持图像参考、源视频/掩码条件与预计算的 VACE 上下文张量，无需上游 VACE 运行时。

recipes.name: Wan2.1-Fun V1.1 14B Control Camera
recipes.summary: Wan2.1-Fun V1.1 14B Control Camera is Alibaba PAI's largest Wan2.1-generation camera-control checkpoint in the VideoX-Fun family: image-to-video generation steered by explicit camera pose sequences.
recipes.summaryZh: Wan2.1-Fun V1.1 14B Control Camera 是阿里云 PAI 在 VideoX-Fun 家族中 Wan2.1 世代最大的相机控制 checkpoint：由显式相机位姿序列操控的图生视频。WorldFoundry 内置 VideoX-Fun（revision 403f1f7b），运行 alibaba-pai/Wan2.1-Fun-V1.1-14B-Control-Camera checkpoint，Apache-2.0 许可。

recipes.name: Wan2.2-Fun 5B Control Camera
recipes.summary: Wan2.2-Fun 5B Control Camera brings the VideoX-Fun camera-control pathway to the Wan2.2 generation at 5B scale: image-to-video steered by explicit camera poses, with an upstream native profile of 121 frames at 24 FPS.
recipes.summaryZh: Wan2.2-Fun 5B Control Camera 将 VideoX-Fun 相机控制通路带入 Wan2.2 世代的 5B 规模：由显式相机位姿操控的图生视频，上游原生规格为 121 帧、24 FPS。权重：alibaba-pai/Wan2.2-Fun-5B-Control-Camera（Apache-2.0）。

recipes.name: Wan2.2-Fun A14B Control Camera
recipes.summary: Wan2.2-Fun A14B Control Camera is the largest Wan2.2-generation camera-control checkpoint in the VideoX-Fun family: an A14B (mixture-of-experts style) diffusion backbone steered by explicit camera pose sequences for image-to-video.
recipes.summaryZh: Wan2.2-Fun A14B Control Camera 是 VideoX-Fun 家族中 Wan2.2 世代最大的相机控制 checkpoint：A14B（专家混合式）扩散骨干，由显式相机位姿序列操控图生视频。使用 alibaba-pai/Wan2.2-Fun-A14B-Control-Camera checkpoint（Apache-2.0 许可）。

recipes.name: WonderJourney
recipes.summary: WonderJourney generates a journey: starting from text or an image, it produces a sequence of connected 3D scenes you travel through — perpetual 3D scene generation rather than a single clip.
recipes.summaryZh: WonderJourney 生成一段「旅程」：从文本或一张图出发，产出一串相互衔接、可穿行的 3D 场景——是持续的 3D 场景生成而非单个片段。WorldFoundry 运行上游 run.py/example_config 流程。

recipes.name: WonderWorld
recipes.providerZh: 斯坦福大学 / 麻省理工学院
recipes.summary: WonderWorld creates a layered Gaussian world from one image and expands it at requested camera views. WorldFoundry runs native diffusion recipes and in-tree scene reconstruction, exporting a standard .splat scene and view previews.
recipes.summaryZh: WonderWorld 从单张图像创建分层高斯世界，并在指定相机视角扩展场景。WorldFoundry 使用原生扩散配方与树内场景重建，导出标准 .splat 场景和视角预览。
aliases: WonderWorld: Interactive 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image

recipes.name: World Labs API
recipes.summary: World Labs API is the hosted route to World Labs' generative world service, for world generation and asset outputs rather than flat video.
recipes.summaryZh: World Labs API 是 World Labs 生成式世界服务的托管入口，用于世界生成与资产输出，而非普通视频。服务在 World Labs 的基础设施上生成可探索的 3D 世界内容，WorldFoundry 将 API 返回的内容保存为产物。

recipes.name: World Labs Marble 1.1
recipes.summary: World Labs Marble 1.1 is a commercial API for 3D world generation: it produces explorable 3D worlds from prompts, accessed through api.worldlabs.ai.
recipes.summaryZh: World Labs Marble 1.1 是 3D 世界生成的商业 API：从提示生成可探索的 3D 世界，经 api.worldlabs.ai 访问。

recipes.name: WorldGen
recipes.summary: WorldGen turns a text prompt or an image into a 3D world: FLUX paints a panorama, which is then reconstructed into a Gaussian splat (default) or a mesh. It covers text-to-3D-world and image-to-3D-world generation and does not output video.
recipes.summaryZh: WorldGen 把文本提示或一张图变成 3D 世界：FLUX 先生成全景图，再重建为高斯溅射（默认）或网格。它覆盖文本到 3D 世界与图像到 3D 世界生成，不输出视频。

recipes.name: WorldPlay2
recipes.summary: WorldPlay2 generates action-controlled world video from an image, with first-person or third-person navigation and chunk-aligned prompt changes.
recipes.summaryZh: WorldPlay2 从图像生成动作可控的世界视频，支持第一或第三人称导航与按块切换提示词。

notes: High-noise and low-noise WorldPlay2 Fast experts.

recipes.name: XGEN-JING Flash v1
recipes.summary: Reuses the canonical MiniMax-H3 DiT, Qwen3-VL conditioner, geometry and scheduler helpers.
recipes.summaryZh: XGEN-JING Flash v1 是来自 XGEN Labs 的世界模型，支持文生视频、图生视频、相机可控视频、世界模型。

recipes.name: Zing-0.5
recipes.summary: Zing-0.5 generates video with frame-aligned keyboard control and prompt switching.
recipes.summaryZh: Zing-0.5 支持按帧键盘控制和提示词切换的视频生成。

recipes.name: A1
recipes.summary: A1 (AffordVLA) is an affordance-guided vision-language-action policy: it grounds manipulation in visual affordances before predicting robot actions.
recipes.summaryZh: A1（AffordVLA）是可供性（affordance）引导的视觉-语言-动作策略：先将操作任务锚定到视觉可供性，再预测机器人动作。

recipes.name: ABot-M0
recipes.providerZh: 高德地图 CV 实验室（阿里巴巴集团）
recipes.summary: ABot-M0 from Amap's CV Lab is a bimanual manipulation VLA built on Qwen3-VL with an AML flow action expert and optional VGGT geometric fusion.
recipes.summaryZh: 高德 CV 实验室的 ABot-M0 是基于 Qwen3-VL 的双臂操作 VLA，搭配 AML flow 动作专家与可选的 VGGT 几何融合。官方发布三个任务权重——ABot-M0-LIBERO、ABot-M0-Robocasa、ABot-M0-RoboTwin2——另有 ModelScope 预训练 checkpoint，全部采用 Apache-2.0 许可。

recipes.name: AdaWorld
recipes.provider: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology / MIT
recipes.providerZh: 香港科技大学 / 麻省理工学院
recipes.summary: AdaWorld extracts latent actions from video to condition an adaptable world model. WorldFoundry runs the released checkpoint on a supplied source video.
recipes.summaryZh: AdaWorld 从视频中提取潜在动作来驱动可适配世界模型。WorldFoundry 使用发布权重和用户提供的源视频推理。

recipes.name: Being-H0.7
recipes.summary: Being-H0.7 is the successor in BeingBeyond's Being-H family: a latent world-action model (WAM) plus robot policy that maps an image, a prompt, and robot state to an action trace.
recipes.summaryZh: Being-H0.7 是 BeingBeyond Being-H 家族的后继模型：隐式世界-动作模型（WAM）加机器人策略，从图像、提示与机器人状态生成动作轨迹。

recipes.name: Causal-rCM
recipes.summary: Causal-rCM applies NVIDIA's rCM consistency distillation to causal video generation: it streams video autoregressively over latent-frame chunks with distilled few-step sampling, making it a low-latency interactive world-model candidate.
recipes.summaryZh: Causal-rCM 把英伟达的 rCM 一致性蒸馏应用于因果视频生成：以潜帧 chunk 为单位自回归流式生成，配合蒸馏的少步采样，是低延迟交互式世界模型的候选。WorldFoundry 运行官方 Apache-2.0 因果推理栈。

recipes.name: Ctrl-World
recipes.providerZh: 清华大学 / 斯坦福大学
recipes.summary: Ctrl-World is a controllable generative world model for robot manipulation: conditioned on robot actions, it predicts future observation video so policies can be evaluated or improved inside the model.
recipes.summaryZh: Ctrl-World 是面向机器人操作的可控生成式世界模型：以机器人动作为条件预测未来观测视频，使策略可以在模型内被评估或改进。已用发布权重验证：按官方默认 25 步采样的五帧合成三视角推理在三个视角中都保留了场景细节。

recipes.name: CUT3R
recipes.providerZh: 加州大学伯克利分校（UC Berkeley）
recipes.summary: CUT3R is a continuous 3D perception model with persistent state: it ingests a stream of images and continuously updates a metric-scale 3D reconstruction, without offline bundling.
recipes.summaryZh: CUT3R 是带持久状态的连续 3D 感知模型：接收图像流并持续更新米制尺度的 3D 重建，无需离线捆绑优化。WorldFoundry 提供树内点云导出与两段式 3DGS 两条路径，均可在 Studio 中使用。CUT3R 同时是 VMem 的几何主干。

recipes.name: DB-CogACT / Dexbotic
recipes.summary: DB-CogACT is the CogACT recipe rebuilt inside Dexmal's Dexbotic framework, with an unusually complete released checkpoint zoo: single-arm and dual-arm foundations plus task checkpoints for LIBERO, CALVIN, and SimplerEnv, all Apache-2.0.
recipes.summaryZh: DB-CogACT 是在 Dexmal 的 Dexbotic 框架内重建的 CogACT 配方，发布的 checkpoint 阵容相当完整：单臂与双臂基础模型，外加 LIBERO、CALVIN、SimplerEnv 任务 checkpoint，全部 Apache-2.0。

recipes.name: Depth Anything 3
recipes.summary: Depth Anything 3 is ByteDance Seed's geometry foundation model: beyond monocular depth it predicts consistent geometry from multiple views. WorldFoundry runs the official SOH export route.
recipes.summaryZh: Depth Anything 3 是字节 Seed 团队的几何基础模型：在单目深度之外还能从多视角预测一致几何。WorldFoundry 运行官方 SOH 导出路径。

recipes.name: Dexora 1B
recipes.summary: Dexora 1B is a dexterous bimanual manipulation VLA built on a 1B RDT policy backbone (paper: arXiv 2605.18722, MIT license).
recipes.summaryZh: Dexora 1B 是灵巧双臂操作 VLA，基于 1B RDT 策略骨干（论文：arXiv 2605.18722，MIT 许可）。WorldFoundry 提供完整推理栈——SigLIP/T5 编码器、严格 checkpoint 加载器、扩散采样器与 36 自由度动作契约——但作者只发布了数据与训练代码，无官方策略权重，因此需要使用你自己训练的 checkpoint 运行。

recipes.name: DM0
recipes.summary: DM0 is Dexmal's Dexbotic-family flow-matching VLA: a Qwen3 flow action expert with merged prefix/suffix attention and triple-view preprocessing.
recipes.summaryZh: DM0 是 Dexmal 的 Dexbotic 家族 flow-matching VLA：Qwen3 flow 动作专家，合并前后缀注意力与三视角预处理。官方发布 base 与 LIBERO 两个 checkpoint（Dexmal/DM0-base、Dexmal/DM0-libero，CC 许可）；完整推理环路——归一化加 Euler 采样器——在进程内从本地 checkpoint 运行。

recipes.name: EgoWM
recipes.summary: EgoWM is an egocentric navigation world model: from a first-person view and navigation actions it predicts the video a moving agent would see.
recipes.summaryZh: EgoWM 是第一人称导航世界模型：给定第一视角画面与导航动作，预测移动智能体将看到的视频。提供 3 自由度动作与 25 自由度状态／动作两个 variant（egowm-svd-3dof / egowm-svd-25dof）。已在 GPU 上用一条配对 25 自由度 EVE1x 样例和一条配对 3 自由度 SCAND 轨迹验证。

recipes.name: EventVLA
recipes.summary: EventVLA from InternRobotics is a long-horizon-memory VLA: on top of a Qwen3-VL-4B base it adds an event head, temporal anchors, and a raw keyframe-image memory so the policy remembers what already happened in long tasks.
recipes.summaryZh: InternRobotics 的 EventVLA 是长时程记忆 VLA：在 Qwen3-VL-4B 基座上增加事件头、时间锚点与原始关键帧图像记忆，使策略在长任务中记住已发生的事件。默认策略为 Apache-2.0 的 ganlinyang/EventVLA checkpoint 集合中的 RoboTwin-MeM 子目录。

recipes.name: Galaxea G0Plus
recipes.summary: Galaxea G0Plus is Galaxea AI's open VLA policy, released with the OpenGalaxea/G0-VLA checkpoint on a PaliGemma-3B base.
recipes.summaryZh: Galaxea G0Plus 是星海图（Galaxea AI）的开放 VLA 策略，发布 OpenGalaxea/G0-VLA checkpoint，基座为 PaliGemma-3B。WorldFoundry 将完整推理路径内置树内——模型架构、KV cache、flow 采样器、严格 checkpoint 加载器、tokenizer 适配器、预处理与归一化。

recipes.name: Genie Envisioner
recipes.summary: Genie Envisioner is AgiBot's robotics world model platform: a video-generative backbone that predicts action-conditioned robot manipulation futures, usable for policy learning and evaluation.
recipes.summaryZh: Genie Envisioner 是智元机器人的机器人世界模型平台：以视频生成为骨干，预测动作条件下的机器人操作未来，可用于策略学习与评估。WorldFoundry 内置其官方（WorldArena 收录的）源码；运行需要 Genie-Envisioner 与 LTX-Video checkpoint 及机器人任务资产。

recipes.name: GigaWorld-0
recipes.summary: GigaWorld-0 is GigaAI's open robotics world-model series, with pretrain and GR1-specialized 2B video checkpoints.
recipes.summaryZh: GigaWorld-0 是极佳科技开源的机器人世界模型系列，包含预训练和 GR1 专用两个 2B 视频 checkpoint。当前接入的 GR1 推理入口根据首帧图像和文本提示生成视频，没有结构化机器人动作输入。

recipes.name: GO-1
recipes.summary: GO-1 is the flagship policy of the AgiBot World project (AgiBot with OpenDriveLab): a generalist robot policy trained on the large-scale AgiBot World dataset, released as agibot-world/GO-1 under CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0.
recipes.summaryZh: GO-1 是 AgiBot World 项目（智元机器人联合 OpenDriveLab）的旗舰策略：在大规模 AgiBot World 数据集上训练的通用机器人策略，以 agibot-world/GO-1 发布，CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 许可。

recipes.name: H-RDT
recipes.summary: H-RDT (Human-to-Robotics Diffusion Transformer) pretrains a diffusion-transformer policy on large-scale human manipulation data before robot fine-tuning (paper: arXiv 2507.23523, MPL-2.0).
recipes.summaryZh: H-RDT（Human-to-Robotics Diffusion Transformer）先在大规模人类操作数据上预训练扩散 transformer 策略，再做机器人微调（论文：arXiv 2507.23523，MPL-2.0）。官方发布为 48 维人体动作预训练 checkpoint（embodiedfoundation/H-RDT）。

recipes.name: HappyOyster
recipes.summary: HappyOyster is a commercial world-model API product published through its product site (happyoyster.cn) rather than a code repository. WorldFoundry lists it for reference only: no runnable API client or generation pipeline exists for it.
recipes.summaryZh: HappyOyster 是商业世界模型 API 产品，通过产品官网（happyoyster.cn）而非代码仓库发布。WorldFoundry 仅将其列作参考：没有可运行的 API 客户端或生成 pipeline。

recipes.name: HMA
