recipes.summary: HMA (Heterogeneous Masked Autoregression) models robot action-video dynamics across heterogeneous embodiments and datasets, fast enough for real-time interaction.
recipes.summaryZh: HMA（异构掩码自回归）跨异构机器人形态与数据集建模「动作-视频」动力学，速度足以支撑实时交互。variant 覆盖 MAGVIT 风格的 362M 离散模型与 1B MAR 连续模型。WorldFoundry 从本地就位的官方源码运行生成器；checkpoint 与机器人资产需在本地就位。

recipes.name: HunyuanWorld 1.0
recipes.summary: HunyuanWorld 1.0 generates immersive, explorable 3D worlds from text or an image — the first generation of Tencent's open world-generation stack, exporting layered panoramas and mesh scenes.
recipes.summaryZh: HunyuanWorld 1.0 从文本或一张图生成沉浸式、可探索的 3D 世界——腾讯开源世界生成栈的第一代，导出分层全景与网格场景。WorldFoundry 运行官方源码路径；生成前需就位 checkpoint 与第三方资产。

recipes.name: HY-World 2.0 Trajectory Renderer
recipes.summary: HY-World 2.0 Trajectory Renderer is one stage of Tencent's world-generation chain: it renders camera-controlled video from a pre-materialized HY-World scene point cloud (render_results/global_pcd.ply) along a camera JSON.
recipes.summaryZh: HY-World 2.0 轨迹渲染器是腾讯世界生成链中的一个阶段：沿 camera JSON 从预先物化的 HY-World 场景点云（render_results/global_pcd.ply）渲染相机可控视频。它不加载任何模型 checkpoint——是渲染器，不是生成器。

recipes.name: Infinite VGGT
recipes.summary: Infinite VGGT (StreamVGGT) turns the feed-forward VGGT reconstructor into a streaming model: it processes incoming frames causally with cached tokens, so reconstruction extends indefinitely instead of being bounded by a fixed window.
recipes.summaryZh: Infinite VGGT（StreamVGGT）把前馈重建器 VGGT 改造成流式模型：用缓存 token 因果地处理到来的帧，使重建可以无限延伸而不受固定窗口限制。

recipes.name: InternVLA-A1-3B
recipes.summary: InternVLA-A1-3B is the A1 generation of InternRobotics' InternVLA series: a 3B policy pairing a Qwen3-VL-2B backbone with an action expert and an NVIDIA Cosmos tokenizer wrapper.
recipes.summaryZh: InternVLA-A1-3B 是 InternRobotics InternVLA 系列的 A1 世代：3B 策略，Qwen3-VL-2B 骨干搭配动作专家与 NVIDIA Cosmos tokenizer 封装。base 与 RoboTwin 两个 checkpoint（InternVLA-A1-3B、InternVLA-A1-3B-RoboTwin）以 CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 许可发布，

recipes.name: Latent Action Pretraining
recipes.summary: LAPA (Latent Action Pretraining) learns actions without action labels: it pretrains a video-action model on unlabeled video by discovering latent actions, then transfers to real robot control.
recipes.summaryZh: LAPA（Latent Action Pretraining）无需动作标签学习动作：在无标注视频上通过发现隐式动作预训练视频-动作模型，再迁移到真实机器人控制。WorldFoundry 使用 MIT 许可的 LAPA-7B-openx checkpoint 运行隐式动作推理。

recipes.name: LDA-1B
recipes.summary: LDA-1B is a 1B-scale VLA policy combining Qwen3-VL language-vision assembly with a DINOv3-ViT compatibility model and an MMDiT action sampler, released for RoboCasa (Wayer2/LDA-robocasa, CC-BY-NC-4.0).
recipes.summaryZh: LDA-1B 是 1B 规模的 VLA 策略，将 Qwen3-VL 视觉-语言组装、DINOv3-ViT 兼容模型与 MMDiT 动作采样器结合，面向 RoboCasa 发布（Wayer2/LDA-robocasa，CC-BY-NC-4.0）。

recipes.name: LeWorldModel
recipes.provider: Mila – Quebec AI Institute / Université de Montréal
recipes.providerZh: Mila 魁北克人工智能研究所 / 蒙特利尔大学
recipes.summary: LeWorldModel (le-wm) studies latent world models: JEPA-style and pixel-space world models trained and evaluated on control tasks such as PushT.
recipes.summaryZh: LeWorldModel（le-wm）研究潜空间世界模型：在 PushT 等控制任务上训练与评估 JEPA 式及像素空间世界模型。WorldFoundry 以仅推理方式运行官方评估路径；执行需要 stable-worldmodel 包、任务数据集，以及策略非随机时的策略 checkpoint。

recipes.name: LingBot-VA
recipes.providerZh: 蚂蚁灵波科技（Robbyant，蚂蚁集团）
recipes.summary: LingBot-VA is Robbyant's video-action model, served through a vendored server/client runtime, with a base checkpoint plus RoboTwin and LIBERO-Long post-trained checkpoints (Apache-2.0).
recipes.summaryZh: LingBot-VA 是蚂蚁灵波科技（Robbyant）的视频-动作模型，经内置的 server/client 运行时提供服务，提供 base 以及 RoboTwin、LIBERO-Long 后训练 checkpoint（Apache-2.0）。在 80GB GPU 上，base transformer 可完成 CUDA 前向，LIBERO-Long 服务可启动并监听 websocket；端到端客户端 rollout 尚未验证。

recipes.name: LingBot-VLA
recipes.providerZh: 蚂蚁灵波科技（Robbyant，蚂蚁集团）
recipes.summary: LingBot-VLA is Robbyant's 4B vision-language-action policy line: a pretrained base plus RoboTwin post-trained and depth-enhanced RoboTwin variants, all Apache-2.0 with pinned revisions on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
recipes.summaryZh: LingBot-VLA 是蚂蚁灵波科技（Robbyant）的 4B 视觉-语言-动作策略线：预训练 base，加 RoboTwin 后训练与深度增强 RoboTwin 变体，全部 Apache-2.0，并在 Hugging Face 与 ModelScope 锁定 revision。WorldFoundry 将官方策略、特征变换、机器人映射与归一化资产直接内置树内，作为进程内运行时。

recipes.name: LingBot-VLA 2.0
recipes.providerZh: 蚂蚁灵波科技（Robbyant，蚂蚁集团）
recipes.summary: LingBot-VLA 2.0 is Robbyant's 6B second-generation VLA built on a Qwen3-VL mixture-of-experts policy, released as robbyant/lingbot-vla-v2-6b under Apache-2.0.
recipes.summaryZh: LingBot-VLA 2.0 是蚂蚁灵波科技（Robbyant）的 6B 第二代 VLA，基于 Qwen3-VL 专家混合策略，以 robbyant/lingbot-vla-v2-6b 发布，Apache-2.0 许可。WorldFoundry 运行官方策略推理，包括批处理、特征变换、机器人映射与归一化。

recipes.name: Mem-0
recipes.summary: Mem-0 ("Memory Matters") is a memory-augmented manipulation policy from the RoboTwin RMBench line: an episodic memory bank lets the policy execute multi-task sequences that depend on what happened earlier.
recipes.summaryZh: Mem-0（“Memory Matters”）是 RoboTwin RMBench 线的记忆增强操作策略：情节记忆库使策略能执行依赖既往事件的多任务序列。qiuly/Mem-0-m1mix-RMBench checkpoint 面向已发表的 M1 多任务执行设定。

recipes.name: MineWorld
recipes.summary: MineWorld is Microsoft's real-time open-source interactive world model for Minecraft: an autoregressive transformer that plays forward Minecraft scenes from image/video context and actions (arXiv 2504.08388, MIT license).
recipes.summaryZh: MineWorld 是微软面向 Minecraft 的实时开源交互世界模型：自回归 Transformer，从图像/视频上下文与动作向前推演 Minecraft 场景（arXiv 2504.08388，MIT 许可）。运行需要官方依赖环境、checkpoint 与验证/demo 数据。

recipes.name: MosaicMem
recipes.summary: MosaicMem is a memory-augmented world-model component: it ingests keyframe patches, retrieves target views, summarizes coverage, and composes latent canvases — producing a memory index rather than video.
recipes.summaryZh: MosaicMem 是记忆增强的世界模型组件：摄取关键帧 patch、检索目标视图、汇总覆盖度并组合潜空间画布——产物是记忆索引而非视频。它通过 worldfoundry.core.memory 暴露。

recipes.name: MotionBricks
recipes.summary: MotionBricks is part of NVIDIA's GR00T-WholeBodyControl stack: it generates humanoid whole-body motion — the action side of embodied world modeling, emitting action traces rather than video (paper arXiv 2604.24833).
recipes.summaryZh: MotionBricks 属于英伟达 GR00T-WholeBodyControl 栈：生成人形机器人全身运动——具身世界建模的动作侧，产物是动作轨迹而非视频（论文 arXiv 2604.24833）。

recipes.name: MoVerse
recipes.summary: MoVerse turns one image into a navigable world: it builds a panoramic Gaussian scaffold from the input and generates camera-controlled video as you move through it. Validated on an H100: the pipeline runs the complete 161-frame path.
recipes.summaryZh: MoVerse 把一张图变成可游走的世界：从输入构建全景高斯脚手架，并在移动过程中生成相机可控视频。已在 H100 上验证：pipeline 可跑通完整的 161 帧路径。

recipes.name: Navigation World Models
recipes.summary: Navigation World Models (NWM) is Meta's navigation world model (CVPR 2025 highlight): a conditional diffusion transformer that predicts egocentric future video from past frames and navigation actions, and can plan trajectories by…
recipes.summaryZh: Navigation World Models（NWM）是 Meta 的导航世界模型（CVPR 2025 highlight）：条件扩散 Transformer，从历史帧与导航动作预测第一视角未来视频，并能通过「想象」来规划轨迹。variant 覆盖 RECON 与 SCAND 数据集 checkpoint。运行前需在本地就位 checkpoint 与评估数据集。

recipes.name: Oasis 500M
recipes.summary: Oasis 500M (open-oasis) is the open release of the playable-Minecraft world model: an action-conditioned diffusion transformer that renders the next game frame from context frames and keyboard/mouse actions.
recipes.summaryZh: Oasis 500M（open-oasis）是「可游玩 Minecraft」世界模型的开源版本：动作条件扩散 Transformer，从上下文帧与键鼠动作渲染下一游戏帧。已通过真实权重 GPU 推理验证。运行前需就位 Etched/oasis-500m 权重、提示图像或视频以及动作张量。

recipes.name: OmniForcing
recipes.summary: OmniForcing is a real-time audio-visual world model built with distillation: it targets joint audio-video generation at interactive speed.
recipes.summaryZh: OmniForcing 是以蒸馏构建的实时音视频世界模型：目标是交互速度下的音视频联合生成。WorldFoundry 将官方源码绑定在固定 commit；生成前需在本地就位 checkpoint 与运行时资产。

recipes.name: Open Dreamer
recipes.summary: Open Dreamer is an open reimplementation of the Dreamer 4 interactive world model (paper arXiv 2509.24527): a diffusion world model that plays Minecraft-style scenes forward from a context clip and VPT-format actions.
recipes.summaryZh: Open Dreamer 是 Dreamer 4 交互世界模型的开源复现（论文 arXiv 2509.24527）：扩散世界模型，从上下文片段与 VPT 格式动作向前推演 Minecraft 风格场景。上游声明「保留所有权利」，因此 WorldFoundry 不内置其 JAX 源码，而是以子进程运行用户自备的官方代码检出。

recipes.name: pi0
recipes.summary: pi0 is Physical Intelligence's flagship flow-matching VLA: a PaliGemma-based backbone with an action expert that decodes continuous action chunks via flow matching.
recipes.summaryZh: pi0 是 Physical Intelligence 的旗舰 flow-matching VLA：基于 PaliGemma 的骨干加动作专家，经 flow matching 解码连续动作块。

recipes.name: pi0-FAST
recipes.summary: pi0-FAST is the autoregressive variant of pi0: instead of flow matching it uses the FAST action tokenizer to decode actions as discrete tokens, trading some smoothness for faster, simpler decoding.
recipes.summaryZh: pi0-FAST 是 pi0 的自回归变体：不用 flow matching，而以 FAST 动作 tokenizer 将动作解码为离散 token，以少量平滑性换取更快更简单的解码。

recipes.name: pi0.5
recipes.summary: pi0.5 is Physical Intelligence's open-world generalization upgrade of pi0: trained for broader scene and task transfer while keeping the flow-matching VLA recipe.
recipes.summaryZh: pi0.5 是 Physical Intelligence 对 pi0 的开放世界泛化升级：面向更广的场景与任务迁移训练，同时保持 flow-matching VLA 配方。已使用官方 pi05_libero 权重验证：OpenPI 运行时以合成观测在 GPU 上产出 10×7 动作块。

recipes.name: Pi3
recipes.summary: Pi3 (π³) is a feed-forward visual-geometry model that reconstructs 3D scenes, camera trajectories, and point clouds without relying on a fixed reference view — its permutation-equivariant design treats all input views symmetrically.
recipes.summaryZh: Pi3（π³）是前馈式视觉几何模型，重建 3D 场景、相机轨迹与点云，且不依赖固定参考视图——其置换等变设计对所有输入视图一视同仁。

recipes.name: PointWorld
recipes.summary: PointWorld is NVIDIA's point-cloud world model for robotics: instead of predicting pixels it predicts future 3D point-cloud states under actions, giving geometry-native world modeling.
recipes.summaryZh: PointWorld 是英伟达面向机器人的点云世界模型：不预测像素，而是在动作条件下预测未来 3D 点云状态，实现几何原生的世界建模。

recipes.name: RDT-1B
recipes.summary: RDT-1B from Tsinghua's thu-ml group is the Robotics Diffusion Transformer: a 1B diffusion policy pretrained on large multi-robot data with a native 128-dimensional unified action space covering many embodiments.
recipes.summaryZh: 清华大学 thu-ml 团队的 RDT-1B 即 Robotics Diffusion Transformer：1B 扩散策略，在大规模多机器人数据上预训练，原生 128 维统一动作空间覆盖多种本体。WorldFoundry 原生运行 robotics-diffusion-transformer/rdt-1b 预训练策略，包括统一动作模型、两帧三相机预处理与 DPM 推理。

recipes.name: RT-1
recipes.summary: RT-1 (Robotics Transformer 1) is Google Research's pioneering large-scale robot transformer, trained on 130k real-robot episodes to output discretized actions from images and instructions.
recipes.summaryZh: RT-1（Robotics Transformer 1）是谷歌研究院开创性的大规模机器人 transformer，在 13 万条真实机器人示范上训练，从图像与指令输出离散化动作。已用官方权重在 GPU 上离线验证：传入合成 512 维向量时，SavedModel 适配器输出结构正确的动作。

recipes.name: Sana
recipes.summary: Sana is NVIDIA's efficient generation family with twenty variants spanning text-to-image (600M–4.8B, up to 4K), ControlNet-conditioned image generation, Sana-Video 2B text-to-video at 480p/720p, LongSANA long video, and SANA-Streaming…
recipes.summaryZh: Sana 是英伟达的高效生成系列，共二十个 variant，覆盖文生图（600M–4.8B，最高 4K）、ControlNet 条件图像生成、Sana-Video 2B 的 480p/720p 文生视频、LongSANA 长视频，以及 SANA-Streaming 的视频到视频（长时与双向）。

recipes.name: ShotStream
recipes.summary: ShotStream is Kling AI Research's real-time interactive streaming video generator: it targets continuous, interactively steered video streams rather than fixed clips.
recipes.summaryZh: ShotStream 是快手可灵研究团队的实时交互流式视频生成器：目标是连续、可交互操控的视频流，而非固定片段。WorldFoundry 从用户准备的固定 commit 官方源码运行其 4 步因果生成器。

recipes.name: SimWorld
recipes.summary: SimWorld is a simulator-control model rather than a video generator: it drives multi-agent embodied simulation (policy rollouts, world state) through a simulator server and produces world_state artifacts.
recipes.summaryZh: SimWorld 是模拟器控制模型而非视频生成器：通过模拟器服务器驱动多智能体具身仿真（策略滚动、世界状态），产出 world_state 产物。

recipes.name: SmolVLA
recipes.summary: SmolVLA is Hugging Face's compact community VLA: a SmolVLM2-500M vision-language backbone with a flow-matching action expert, small enough for consumer hardware.
recipes.summaryZh: SmolVLA 是 Hugging Face 的紧凑社区 VLA：SmolVLM2-500M 视觉-语言骨干配 flow-matching 动作专家，小到可在消费级硬件运行。HuggingFaceVLA/smolvla_libero 任务 checkpoint 是 rollout 默认，lerobot/smolvla_base 为微调资产。已在 GPU 上用 LIBERO checkpoint 验证：策略返回有限的 1×50×7 动作块。

recipes.name: Spirit-VLA v1.5
recipes.summary: Spirit-VLA v1.5 is Spirit AI's vision-language-action policy on a Qwen3-VL backbone, released as the Spirit-AI-robotics/Spirit-v1.5 base checkpoint.
recipes.summaryZh: Spirit-VLA v1.5 是 Spirit AI（千寻智能）基于 Qwen3-VL 骨干的视觉-语言-动作策略，发布为 Spirit-AI-robotics/Spirit-v1.5 base checkpoint。

recipes.name: StarWM
recipes.summary: StarWM is a multi-agent world model for StarCraft-style environments: it predicts action-conditioned game video across many interacting units.
recipes.summaryZh: StarWM 是面向星际争霸类环境的多智能体世界模型：在大量交互单位下预测动作条件的游戏视频。WorldFoundry 内置官方离线推理客户端；作业通过 OpenAI 兼容的 StarWM 端点交互，使用官方 prompt fixture 格式。checkpoint 为 Hugging Face 上的 yxzhang2024/StarWM。

recipes.name: TesserAct
recipes.provider: University of Massachusetts Amherst (Embodied AGI Lab)
recipes.providerZh: 马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校（Embodied AGI 实验室）
recipes.summary: TesserAct is an embodied 4D world model for robotics: it predicts action-conditioned video of manipulation scenes with temporally consistent geometry.
recipes.summaryZh: TesserAct 是面向机器人的具身 4D 世界模型：预测操作场景的动作条件视频，并保持时序一致的几何。它是 WorldArena 收录的开源世界模型之一；权重发布在 Hugging Face 的 anyeZHY/tesseract。

recipes.name: Uni3C
recipes.summary: Uni3C from Alibaba DAMO Academy unifies camera control and human-motion control for image-to-video generation: the PCDController stage steers the camera while the unified stage combines camera plus human motion (RealisDance-DiT).
recipes.summaryZh: 阿里巴巴达摩院的 Uni3C 将相机控制与人体动作控制统一到图生视频中：PCDController 阶段负责相机操控，统一阶段结合相机与人体动作（RealisDance-DiT）。WorldFoundry 运行两条官方第二阶段推理路径，使用公开的 Apache-2.0 checkpoint（ewrfcas/Uni3C、theFoxofSky/RealisDance-DiT），构建在 Wan2.1-I2V-14B-720P 基座之上。

recipes.name: Unified World Models
recipes.providerZh: 华盛顿大学（WEIRD 实验室）
recipes.summary: Unified World Models (UWM) from the University of Washington's WEIRD Lab couples video prediction and action diffusion in one robot world model, with variants for LIBERO-90 (uwm-libero90) and DROID (uwm-droid).
recipes.summaryZh: 华盛顿大学 WEIRD 实验室的 Unified World Models（UWM）将视频预测与动作扩散耦合进同一个机器人世界模型，提供 LIBERO-90（uwm-libero90）与 DROID（uwm-droid）两个变体。WorldFoundry 运行官方评测路由；生成前需就位 checkpoint 与数据集。

recipes.name: VGGT
recipes.providerZh: Meta AI（FAIR）/ 牛津大学 VGG 组
recipes.summary: VGGT (Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer, CVPR 2025) is a feed-forward network that infers cameras, depth maps, point maps, and 3D point tracks from one to hundreds of views in a single pass — no per-scene optimization.
recipes.summaryZh: VGGT（Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer，CVPR 2025）是前馈网络：单次前向即可从一到数百个视图推断相机、深度图、点图与 3D 点轨迹——无需逐场景优化。

recipes.name: VGGT-World
recipes.summary: VGGT-World builds a world model on top of VGGT-style 3D scene understanding: it couples geometry-grounded scene perception with video generation so rollouts stay consistent with the underlying 3D structure.
recipes.summaryZh: VGGT-World 在 VGGT 式 3D 场景理解之上构建世界模型：将几何锚定的场景感知与视频生成耦合，使滚动生成与底层 3D 结构保持一致。WorldFoundry 接入官方源码（论文：arXiv 2603.12655）；生成前需在本地就位 checkpoint 与资产。

recipes.name: Vid2World
recipes.providerZh: 清华大学（THUML 机器学习组）
recipes.summary: Vid2World from Tsinghua's THUML group turns pretrained video diffusion models into interactive world models: it adapts a passive video generator into an action-conditioned, autoregressive predictor.
recipes.summaryZh: 清华大学 THUML 组的 Vid2World 将预训练视频扩散模型改造为交互式世界模型：把被动的视频生成器适配成动作条件的自回归预测器。WorldFoundry 运行官方评测路由。

recipes.name: WildDet3D
recipes.summary: WildDet3D from the Allen Institute for AI recovers 3D object boxes from unconstrained RGB imagery. WorldFoundry runs the pinned official detector and writes its detections and depth map to a NumPy archive.
recipes.summaryZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（AI2）的 WildDet3D 从真实 RGB 图像中恢复物体的三维框。WorldFoundry 运行固定版本的官方检测器，将检测框和深度图保存为 NumPy 文件。

recipes.name: WildWorld
recipes.summary: WildWorld is a benchmark and dataset rather than a generative model: it evaluates world models on in-the-wild footage and produces evaluation reports.
recipes.summaryZh: WildWorld 是基准与数据集，而非生成模型：在野外真实素材上评测世界模型并产出评测报告。WorldFoundry 运行官方源码（ShandaAI/WildWorld）；运行前请就位基准与数据集资产。

recipes.name: WorldGrow
recipes.summary: WorldGrow generates worlds by expansion: starting from a seed scene it progressively grows coherent 3D world blocks, targeting interactive world generation and scene extension.
recipes.summaryZh: WorldGrow 以扩张方式生成世界：从种子场景出发逐步生长出连贯的 3D 世界块，面向交互式世界生成与场景扩展。UranusITS/WorldGrow checkpoint 发布在 Hugging Face 上；WorldFoundry 运行官方源码，需要在本地就位 checkpoint 与 TRELLIS 资产。

recipes.name: WorldMem
recipes.summary: WorldMem targets the core weakness of interactive world models — forgetting: it equips a Minecraft-style interactive world model with an explicit memory so revisited places stay consistent over long horizons (paper: arXiv 2504.12369).
recipes.summaryZh: WorldMem 针对交互式世界模型的核心弱点——遗忘：为 Minecraft 式交互世界模型加装显式记忆，使重访地点在长时程下保持一致（论文：arXiv 2504.12369）。

recipes.name: WoW
recipes.providerZh: X-Humanoid（北京人形机器人创新中心）
recipes.summary: WoW is X-Humanoid's embodied world model family for action-conditioned image-to-video, with four checkpoint lines: Wan 1.3B-2M (MIT), Wan 14B-600k (official demo default), Wan 14B-2M (official recommendation), and a DiT 2B development line.
recipes.summaryZh: WoW 是 X-Humanoid 的具身世界模型家族，面向动作条件图生视频，包含四条 checkpoint 线：Wan 1.3B-2M（MIT）、Wan 14B-600k（官方 demo 默认）、Wan 14B-2M（官方推荐），以及 DiT 2B 开发线。已验证：发布的 Wan 1.3B-2M checkpoint 可加载到原生 Wan 模型，结构完全匹配。

recipes.name: X-WAM
recipes.summary: X-WAM is a world-action model: one Wan 2.2 joint flow process predicts future RGB/depth, proprioception, and robot actions together (Apache-2.0).
recipes.summaryZh: X-WAM 是世界-动作模型：单个 Wan 2.2 联合 flow 过程同时预测未来 RGB/深度、本体感知与机器人动作（Apache-2.0）。已使用发布权重在 GPU 上验证：RoboCasa-SFT 可输出动作与未来 RGB 帧，RoboTwin-SFT 在一条配对的域内样本上与固定版本官方 Runner 接近一致。

recipes.name: Xiaomi-Robotics-1
recipes.summary: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 is Xiaomi's next-generation VLA (Apache-2.0): a Qwen3-VL policy-token graph with a rectified-flow DiT action decoder emitting relative actions. Checkpoints are staged locally under WORLDFOUNDRY_CKPT_DIR.
recipes.summaryZh: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 是小米的下一代 VLA（Apache-2.0）：Qwen3-VL 策略 token 图配 rectified flow DiT 动作解码器，输出相对动作。checkpoint 需在本地就位于 WORLDFOUNDRY_CKPT_DIR。

recipes.name: ABot-World-0-5B-LF
recipes.providerZh: 阿里巴巴（高德地图 AMAP-CVLab）
recipes.summary: ABot-World-0-5B-LF is Amap's interactive world model: give it an image plus actions and it rolls out world video block by block, keeping causal KV state resident between action blocks.
recipes.summaryZh: ABot-World-0-5B-LF 是高德的交互式世界模型：输入一张图加动作序列，它逐块滚动生成世界视频，并在动作块之间保持因果 KV 状态常驻。已在 A100 上用公开的 0.5B-LF checkpoint 验证：在官方 1280×704 分辨率下，一个动作块生成可正常解码的九帧 H.264 视频。

recipes.name: FastWAM
recipes.summary: FastWAM is a world-action model built on the Wan video stack (MIT license). Validated with the released checkpoints: the LIBERO and RoboTwin base checkpoints produce finite 32-step action chunks, and the separate LIBERO Optional IDM…
recipes.summaryZh: FastWAM 是基于 Wan 视频栈的世界动作模型（MIT 许可）。已用发布权重验证：LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 基础权重输出有限的 32 步动作块，独立的 LIBERO Optional IDM 权重在 idm 与 first_frame 两种模式下输出有限的 8 步动作块。

recipes.name: HY-World 2.0
recipes.summary: HY-World 2.0 is Tencent's second-generation world stack with three components: HY-Pano 2.0 panorama generation, WorldMirror 2.0 reconstruction, and full text/image-to-3D-world generation.
recipes.summaryZh: HY-World 2.0 是腾讯第二代世界生成栈，包含三个组件：HY-Pano 2.0 全景生成、WorldMirror 2.0 重建，以及完整文/图到 3D 世界生成。WorldFoundry 运行全景与重建组件；完整世界生成仅能用上游代码运行。已验证的 WorldMirror 2.0 重建路径导出深度、法线、点云、高斯泼溅、相机参数、COLMAP 文件与 RRD 场景元数据。

recipes.name: MME-VLA
recipes.summary: MME-VLA is the policy-learning line of the RoboMME project, centered on perceptual frame sampling for memory-heavy manipulation.
recipes.summaryZh: MME-VLA 是 RoboMME 项目的策略学习线，核心是面向重记忆操作的感知帧采样。它提供四个 Apache-2.0 checkpoint 仓库：最佳感知帧采样模块、mme_vla_suite 集合、pi05 基线与 VLM 子目标预测器。

recipes.name: OpenVLA-OFT
recipes.summary: OpenVLA-OFT applies optimized fine-tuning to OpenVLA (parallel decoding, continuous action heads, and action chunking) and is released as five LIBERO checkpoints under the MIT license.
recipes.summaryZh: OpenVLA-OFT 对 OpenVLA 施加优化微调（并行解码、连续动作头与动作分块），以五个 LIBERO checkpoint 发布，MIT 许可。已在 A100 上验证：五个 checkpoint 均输出确定性的 8x7 动作块，峰值显存 14.47 GiB。

recipes.name: Spatial-Forcing
recipes.summary: Spatial-Forcing aligns VLA internal representations with 3D geometry (via VGGT-style supervision) to boost manipulation precision on OpenVLA backbones.
recipes.summaryZh: Spatial-Forcing 将 VLA 内部表征与 3D 几何对齐（借助 VGGT 式监督），提升 OpenVLA 骨干的操作精度。四个已发布 OpenVLA-LIBERO checkpoint（spatial、object、goal、long；Apache-2.0）均已验证：严格恢复后在 A100 推理中输出有限的 8x7 动作块。

recipes.name: VLANeXt
recipes.summary: VLANeXt is a next-generation VLA released under the S-Lab License 1.0 (source-available, research-oriented), with official LIBERO and LIBERO-plus checkpoints in the DravenALG/VLANeXt collection.
recipes.summaryZh: VLANeXt 是以 S-Lab License 1.0（源码可得、面向研究）发布的新一代 VLA，官方 LIBERO 与 LIBERO-plus checkpoint 收录于 DravenALG/VLANeXt 集合。WorldFoundry 从内置推理子集在进程内调用官方 get_vla/get_processor/get_vla_action 契约，无需外部 checkout。

recipes.name: Wan2.1-Fun V1.1 1.3B Control Camera
recipes.summary: Wan2.1-Fun V1.1 1.3B Control Camera is the 1.3B camera-control model of the VideoX-Fun family: it generates video from an image along explicit camera poses.
recipes.summaryZh: Wan2.1-Fun V1.1 1.3B Control Camera 是 VideoX-Fun 家族的 1.3B 相机控制模型：按显式相机位姿从图像生成视频。已用发布的 checkpoint 验证：官方位姿条件路由经四步去噪生成 672x384 的九帧连贯 H.264 视频。

recipes.name: X-VLA
recipes.providerZh: 清华大学智能产业研究院（AIR）
recipes.summary: X-VLA is a cross-embodiment VLA built on a Florence-2 backbone with soft-prompt domain conditioning (paper: arXiv 2510.10274, Apache-2.0).
recipes.summaryZh: X-VLA 是跨本体 VLA，基于 Florence-2 骨干与软提示域条件（论文：arXiv 2510.10274，Apache-2.0）。已在 A100 上验证：九个已发布 checkpoint 均可严格加载，并在显式域 ID 下产出有限的 30x20 动作，动作头输出与上游一致。

recipes.name: Xiaomi-Robotics-0
recipes.summary: Xiaomi-Robotics-0 is Xiaomi's open VLA policy line with an unusually complete Apache-2.0 benchmark zoo: checkpoints for LIBERO, CALVIN ABCD-D, CALVIN ABC-D, SimplerEnv Google Robot, and SimplerEnv WidowX, plus a pretrained base checkpoint.
recipes.summaryZh: Xiaomi-Robotics-0 是小米的开放 VLA 策略线，Apache-2.0 基准阵容非常完整：提供 LIBERO、CALVIN ABCD-D、CALVIN ABC-D、SimplerEnv Google Robot 与 SimplerEnv WidowX 的 checkpoint，以及一个预训练基座 checkpoint。默认使用 LIBERO checkpoint。

recipes.name: World Observer
recipes.summary: World Observer studies persistent world modeling through joint actor-observer generation. The official repository publishes the paper and release plan.
recipes.summaryZh: World Observer 通过联合生成 actor 与 observer 视角研究持久世界建模，官方仓库当前公布论文及发布计划。
